title: Accessibility Testing Lead
description:
**Position overview**

We are looking for a lead-level Accessibility QA Engineer who still tests hands-on. You will guide engineering on accessible implementation, run knowledge sessions for engineering and product, and write an accessibility plan for a platform. The plan states the testing the platform needs and the support and budget it does not yet have. Quality engineering uses that plan to request both.

You will audit against WCAG 2.2, targeting AA, with awareness of AAA where relevant, and you need working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 at A and AA. Audits use screen readers, keyboard-only navigation, and automated scanners. You will own the accessibility testing process, from test plans, severity, regression, and sign-off through CI gates, remediation guidance, and stakeholder reporting. An accessibility certification is not required.

You will manage and mentor the accessibility QA team, and report conformance and regulatory risk in writing that both engineers and legal or compliance staff can use.

This position is intended for Hyderabad-based candidates who are available to work from the office.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct accessibility audits and risk assessments against WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA, with awareness of relevant Level AAA criteria.
* Test semantic HTML, WAI-ARIA, keyboard interaction, screen-reader behavior, native mobile applications, the DOM, and the accessibility tree.
* Create and review test plans, test cases, and automated accessibility tests using axe-core with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
* Write platform accessibility plans and maintain the testing process, including priorities, definition of done, regression, release-readiness, approved exceptions, risk acceptance, and remediation tracking.
* Shift accessibility left with product, design, and engineering through accessible components, early acceptance criteria, pull-request checks, automated scanners, and CI/CD gates.
* Track conformance, maintain Accessibility Conformance Reports using the appropriate VPAT template, evaluate vendor accessibility claims, and communicate regulatory risk.
* Establish accessibility quality metrics, dashboards, and stakeholder reporting.
* Apply AI-assisted testing and reporting tools with human verification of generated results.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the accessibility QA team through planning, coaching, review, and calibration.
* Train product, design, engineering, and QA teams, and provide actionable remediation guidance through validation.
* Produce technical findings, defect reports, and stakeholder communications for engineering, business, and Legal and Compliance audiences.

**Requirements**

* Lead-level accessibility experience, including hands-on testing and building or operating an accessibility testing process.
* Deep knowledge of WCAG 2.2 testing and conformance, plus US and European requirements including the ADA, Section 508, EN 301 549, and the EAA.
* Practical fluency in WAI-ARIA 1.2, ARIA Authoring Practices, semantic HTML, CSS, accessible names, and expected keyboard interactions.
* Proficiency with NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack, keyboard-only testing, native mobile accessibility, and DOM and accessibility-tree inspection.
* Experience conducting accessibility audits and risk assessments for web and mobile products.
* Experience creating test assets and automated accessibility tests using axe-core with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
* Experience selecting automated scanners and integrating accessibility into design reviews, pull requests, and CI/CD.
* Experience writing accessibility plans and defining testing scope, priorities, quality gates, exceptions, and remediation tracking.
* Experience authoring and reviewing Accessibility Conformance Reports, selecting the appropriate VPAT template, and evaluating vendor accessibility claims.
* Experience defining accessibility metrics and using AI-assisted tools with appropriate human verification.
* Experience leading and training QA or accessibility teams and working with product, design, and engineering.
* Ability to explain user impact and provide actionable remediation guidance through implementation and validation.
* Strong written communication for engineering, business, and Legal and Compliance audiences.

**Nice to have**

* IAAP certification such as CPACC, WAS, or CPWA, or Section 508 Trusted Tester certification.
* PDF and document accessibility experience, including tagged PDF structure and the PAC tool.
* Knowledge of cognitive and low-vision accessibility.
* Experience contributing to or auditing an accessible design system.
* Experience with accessibility maturity models.

Pay: ₹2,400,000.00 - ₹3,400,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Software Development Manager
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Ask any Customer Service Associate what slows them down and they'll show you: the field that doesn't autofill, the extra click on every third contact, the lookup that opens in another tab. None of these earns a spot on a roadmap by itself. Together they cost tens of thousands of associates minutes every day, and well over a thousand such requests reach us every year from the people on the front line.  
  
Your team fixes them. Based in Hyderabad, it has a mandate no other team has: go into any codebase across the associate workspace, ship the fix through the owning team's pipelines and review process, and move to the next one. Each month a scored list of associate-raised problems arrives. Your team sizes them, embeds with the teams that own the code, and ships. Every fix credits the associate who raised it.  
  
What sets this role apart is that you run a mechanism, not just a team. The monthly intake with product leaders, the capacity math, the working relationships with a dozen engineering managers whose code your engineers touch, and the quarterly story to senior leadership about what got better are all yours. You'll also be the one who can say, with evidence, where the workspace's architecture makes small fixes hard. That feeds directly into the 2027 effort to rebuild it as one AI-assisted experience.  
  
You'll lead seven engineers directly and work as a peer with a senior program manager who runs intake and a senior engineer who sets the technical bar, with evenings that overlap partner teams in Seattle, Toronto, and Austin. If you like shipping every week and reading the thank-you notes, this is the job.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own the fix-it mechanism end to end: monthly intake with product and senior leadership, engineer-led estimation, sequencing against capacity, delivery, and a readiness check before each fix reaches associates.  
  
Deliver through embedded execution. Your engineers join the team that owns the affected code as temporary members, follow its design and review norms, use its pipelines and tests, and leave the codebase better than they found it. You make that model work across teams in three cities.  
  
Hire, grow, and retain a team of software engineers spanning early-career to senior. Set and hold the bar on design, code, testing, and documentation, and coach engineers through promotion.  
  
Build and keep trust with every engineering manager whose codebase your team touches. Negotiate access, review bandwidth, and release windows; resolve design disputes through principal engineers rather than around them.  
  
Measure what matters: fixes shipped, associate impact per fix, and mechanism health, reported quarterly to senior leadership.  
  
Deliver through others: remove blockers, make scope calls, and keep stakeholders informed without surprises.  
  
Make the team AI-native: use AI tooling to raise velocity and quality across unfamiliar codebases.  
  
A day in the life  
Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. Mornings in Hyderabad start with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, and a 1:1. Late afternoon you unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review; your evening overlaps North America for a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates.  
  
About the team

* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

title: IT Engineering Manager - Modern Engineering & Legacy Modernization
description:
TJX Companies

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

**Job Description:**

About the Team

The Global Supply Chain (GSC) E-commerce Fulfillment team delivers technology solutions that support fulfillment operations across the TJX network.

We are evolving our technology landscape by modernizing existing applications, strengthening engineering capabilities, and developing new solutions while continuing to support business-critical legacy applications during the transition.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced **Engineering Manager** to build and lead our E-commerce Fulfillment engineering capability in Hyderabad.

This role combines **people leadership, technical leadership, application modernization, and operational ownership**. The successful candidate will lead and develop engineers working across modern and legacy technologies, provide technical guidance across **iSeries and Mainframe environments**, and help drive the transition toward modern application architectures and engineering practices.

The ideal candidate will bring strong modern application engineering experience across **C#, .NET, APIs, integrations, SQL, Azure, DevSecOps, automated testing, and CI/CD**, along with the ability to understand and guide teams working with mature legacy platforms.

The role will working closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, and other technology teams.

What You'll Do

Engineering & People Leadership

  

* Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing engineering team.
* Establish clear engineering expectations, standards, and ways of working.
* Provide technical mentoring and create opportunities for engineers to broaden their capabilities.
* Develop cross-skilling across modern and legacy technology platforms.
* Build technical depth and reduce dependency on highly specialized legacy expertise through knowledge sharing and structured development.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, ownership, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.

Technical Leadership & Modernization

  

* Provide technical leadership across modern application engineering, **iSeries, Mainframe, APIs, integrations, and cloud-based solutions**.
* Guide technical design and engineering decisions for E-commerce Fulfillment applications.
* Lead modernization initiatives that progressively transition legacy application capabilities toward modern engineering patterns.
* Guide teams in understanding existing application code, business logic, interfaces, dependencies, and data flows before modernizing capabilities.

  

* Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, maintainable, secure, and aligned with business needs.
* Balance modernization priorities with the need to maintain stability and continuity across critical existing applications.

Modern Engineering Practices

  

* Drive adoption of **C#, .NET, REST APIs, Azure, modern integration patterns, and automated testing**.
* Champion **DevSecOps, CI/CD, Git-based development, observability, secure engineering, and deployment automation**.
* Improve application reliability, production support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis practices.
* Encourage automation across development, testing, deployment, and operational support.
* Promote effective use of **GitHub Copilot and GenAI-assisted engineering tools** to improve development productivity, testing, documentation, and learning.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering quality and delivery practices.

Legacy Platform Leadership

  

* Provide technical guidance for applications operating across **IBM iSeries/AS400 and Mainframe environments**.
* Ensure appropriate engineering support and knowledge continuity for business-critical legacy applications.
* Guide engineers supporting legacy development, enhancements, defect resolution, and production support.
* Partner with experienced SMEs to strengthen knowledge transfer and documentation.
* Develop cross-platform engineering capability so the team can effectively operate across legacy and modern technologies.
* Identify appropriate opportunities to simplify, integrate, modernize, or progressively replace legacy functionality.

Collaboration & Delivery

  

* Partner with **Product, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, business teams, and vendors** to deliver effective technology solutions.
* Translate business requirements into engineering priorities and technical solutions.
* Contribute to architecture and solution-design discussions.
* Manage technical dependencies, risks, and production issues across multiple applications and technology platforms.
* Partner with stakeholders to balance modernization, engineering investment, operational stability, and business priorities.
* Provide clear technical direction while enabling engineers to take ownership of solution delivery.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  

* Strong experience leading software engineering teams, including **technical mentoring, coaching, and talent development**.
* Strong modern application engineering and solution-design experience.
* Solid understanding of full-stack engineering, including **C#, .NET, REST APIs, enterprise integrations, SQL, and automated testing**.
* Experience with **Azure-hosted applications**, preferably including Azure App Service.
* Strong understanding of **DevSecOps, CI/CD, source control, observability, secure engineering, and production support**.
* Experience leading application development, modernization, or complex technology initiatives.
* Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively across Product, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, business teams, Engineering, and vendors.
* Strong learning agility and experience leading teams working across multiple technology stacks.
* Ability to balance hands-on technical leadership with people leadership and delivery responsibilities.

Technical Skills

Core Skills

  

* Engineering and people leadership
* Exposure to **IBM iSeries / AS400 and Mainframe environments**.
* C# / .NET application engineering
* REST APIs and enterprise integrations

  

* Microsoft Azure / cloud application development

  

* Application modernization
* Legacy-system integration
* GitHub Copilot / GenAI-assisted engineering

Preferred Skills

  

* Experience leading or developing engineers supporting legacy platforms.
* Experience with legacy application modernization or integration.
* Supply chain, fulfillment, warehouse, labeling, or Ticketing domain experience.
* Experience leading environments where modern and legacy technologies coexist during a multi-year modernization journey.
* Experience with GitHub Copilot or comparable AI-assisted software engineering tools.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will establish a strong **E-commerce Fulfillment engineering capability in Hyderabad**, developing engineers who can operate effectively across both modern and legacy technologies.

The Engineering Manager will strengthen technical ownership of existing applications, drive cross-skilling across **iSeries and Mainframe technologies**, and progressively move the engineering landscape toward modern **.NET, API, Azure, DevSecOps, and cloud engineering patterns**.

description:
Job Description
  
  
Associate Director – Forward Deployed Engineering
  
The Opportunity
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  

* Provide hands-on technical and engineering leadership for digitally enabled authoring and localization products, including AI-assisted authoring and machine translation.
* Embed with regulatory authors, translators, localization specialists and product teams to understand high-value problems, rapidly validate ideas and mature successful concepts into maintainable, production-grade solutions.
* Bridge regulatory needs, product strategy, architecture and engineering execution while ensuring security, privacy, validation, auditability, Responsible AI and operational supportability.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Build a strong understanding of regulatory authoring processes, user needs, systems, data and content flows, including clinical and regulatory document development.
* Partner directly with regulatory authors, product managers, architects, data scientists, UX specialists and software engineers to identify high-impact opportunities and translate ambiguous requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Lead rapid discovery, prototyping, user validation, solution shaping, production delivery and adoption for digital and AI-enabled authoring capabilities.
* Design and deliver scalable capabilities for AI-assisted content generation, content reuse, structured content, review and quality control, source-to-output traceability and document intelligence.
* Design and deliver localization and machine-translation capabilities, including terminology management, translation memory, quality estimation, human review workflows, feedback capture and measurable translation-quality monitoring.
* Architect Generative AI solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, enterprise knowledge retrieval and knowledge graph patterns where appropriate.
* Design agentic authoring and review workflows, including orchestration, tool integration, guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Establish prompt engineering, prompt management, evaluation, versioning, reuse and lifecycle practices for dependable Generative AI delivery.
* Design secure, modular and reusable cloud-native architectures, APIs, microservices, event-driven integrations and data pipelines across AWS and, where required, Google Cloud Platform, connecting authoring and localization solutions with regulatory platforms, structured data sources and enterprise AI services.
* Provide hands-on implementation support, reference architectures, design reviews, code-level guidance and reusable engineering patterns.
* Prefer enterprise and out-of-the-box capabilities over unnecessary custom solutions, while clearly documenting trade-offs where custom engineering is justified.
* Embed quality by design through automated testing, AI evaluation, grounding, hallucination controls, performance testing and production-readiness reviews.
* Drive DevOps and MLOps practices including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, monitoring, alerting, model/service observability and release governance.
* Ensure architecture and engineering decisions meet requirements for security, privacy, reliability, scalability, cost, validation, auditability and operational resilience in a regulated environment.
* Implement Responsible AI and AI governance controls, including risk assessment, explainability, transparency, human oversight, monitoring and regulatory readiness.
* Mentor engineers within the Hyderabad Technology Centre and strengthen modern software engineering, AI engineering and AI-assisted development practices.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, reference implementations, decision records and reusable assets that improve delivery consistency and long-term ownership.
* Act as a trusted technical bridge across Regulatory, Product, Architecture, AI/Data Science, Security, Quality and Engineering teams, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.

**Primary skills:**  
Software Engineering Leadership, Python, Generative AI/LLMs, Agentic AI, RAG, Prompt Engineering, REST APIs, SQL/Data Engineering, AWS, Git/GitHub, CI/CD, Docker, Automated Testing, Solution Architecture and Forward-Deployed Engineering.
  
  
**Secondary skills:**  
TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Vector Databases, Knowledge Graphs, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, AI Observability/Evaluation, Enterprise Security, Veeva Vault and regulated life-sciences technology experience.
  
  
**What you Should Have:**  
Education
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Significant experience in software engineering and solution architecture, with demonstrated technical leadership delivering complex enterprise platforms and products into production.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary, globally distributed engineering teams and provide technical direction across architecture, engineering, AI and cloud technologies.
* Strong expertise inPython and modern backend engineering, including REST APIs, microservices and service-oriented architectures.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering production-grade Generative AI solutions using LLMs, embeddings, RAG, vector/semantic search and prompt-driven workflows.
* Strong understanding ofagentic AI architectures, including workflow orchestration, tool use, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls and evaluation.
* Experience designing solutions involvingstructured and unstructured data, document processing, metadata, enterprise search/retrieval and scalable data pipelines.
* Experience withlocalisation or language technologies, including machine translation, multilingual NLP, terminology management, translation memory, automated quality evaluation or human-in-the-loop review.
* Strong experience withAWS and/or Google Cloud Platform and cloud-native architectures, including containers, Kubernetes and serverless patterns.
* Strong understanding ofDevOps and MLOps engineering practices, including Git-based development, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, monitoring and observability.
* Demonstrated ability to make architecture and engineering trade-off decisions across scalability, performance, security, reliability, maintainability, cost and speed of delivery.
* Ability to establishsecure, resilient and compliant engineering solutions, including identity and access management, encryption, logging, auditability and operational controls.
* Strong understanding ofAI evaluation, grounding, Responsible AI, model/service observability and AI risk controls.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into technical strategy, architecture and executable engineering plans, working closely with Product, Business, Architecture and Engineering stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, drive technical decisions and lead engineering teams through complex transformation and delivery.

Our technology teams operate as business partners, proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities. We collaborate internationally to deliver services and solutions that help everyone be more productive and enable innovation.

We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

title: SoC Edge-AI Design Verification Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Tel Aviv, Israel; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience creating and using verification components and environments in standard verification methodology.
* Experience verifying digital logic at RTL level using SystemVerilog or Specman/E for FPGAs or ASICs.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience creating and using verification components and environments in a standard verification methodology (e.g., UVM).
* Experience with verification techniques, and the full verification life cycle.
* Experience with Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) standard interfaces and memory system architecture.
* Experience with performance verification of ASICs and ASIC components.

**About the job**
-----------------

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

In this role, you will work as part of a Research and Development team. You will build verification components, constrained-random testing, system testing, and drive verification closure. You will verify digital designs, collaborate closely with design and verification engineers on projects, and perform direct verification. You will build constrained-random verification environments that exercise designs through their corner-cases and expose all types of bugs. You will manage the full life-cycle of verification, which can range from verification planning, test execution, to collecting and closing coverage.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Plan the verification of digital design blocks by fully understanding the design specification and interacting with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios.
* Create and enhance constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM), or formally verify designs with SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and industry leading formal tools.
* Identify and write all types of coverage measures for corner-cases.
* Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
* Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Associate IS Engineer
description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-256204 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 26, 2026 CATEGORY: Engineering

**ABOUT AMGEN**

  
  

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today.

**Role Description**

We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions.

This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs.

Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams.

The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required.

  
  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application

* Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues.

* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems.

* Perform technical root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective and preventive measures for recurring problems.

* Support incident, problem, request, and change-management processes in accordance with established IT service-management practices.

* Work with business users, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, integration teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues.

* Support application configuration, upgrades, patches, releases, environment changes, and production deployments.

* Support application integrations with enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, identity and access-management solutions, and cloud services.

* Maintain application documentation including architecture and interface details, configuration information, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and support knowledge articles.

* Contribute to application lifecycle activities including technical assessments, upgrades, modernization, remediation, and application retirement where applicable.

* Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required.

**Software Development & Enhancement**

* Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of application enhancements and software solutions.

* Manage the application SDLC and supporting ITIL Lifecyle completely

* Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality.

* Develop or enhance front-end applications using technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.

* Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards.

* Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms.

* Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers.

* Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs.

* Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices.

* Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests.

* Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment.

* Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers.

**Testing, Release & Operational Readiness**

* Create and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests for application changes and releases.

* Support user acceptance testing and resolution of defects identified during testing.

* Validate APIs and system integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent.

* Support release planning, deployment validation, and post-production verification.

* Ensure appropriate technical and support documentation is available before solutions transition into production.

* Work with support teams to ensure operational readiness for new applications, enhancements, integrations, and releases.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, application owners, developers, QA professionals, DevOps teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors.

* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives.

* Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, automate repetitive operational activities, and reduce recurring support issues.

* Stay current with emerging technologies and practices across application development, cloud, DevOps, API integration, observability, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience**

* Master's / Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.

* Experience may include a combination of application development, application engineering, production/application support, system integration, testing, or IT operations.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Good understanding of information systems, application architecture, software-development lifecycle, and application-support lifecycle.

* Experience supporting business or enterprise applications in development, test, and/or production environments.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to investigate application incidents, software defects, integration failures, and data-related issues.

* Working knowledge of REST APIs and application integrations.

* Hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and/or TypeScript.

Test Engineer - Integrations

**Role Summary**

Candescent is transforming digital banking with a modern, AI-powered platform that empowers financial institutions to deliver smarter, faster, and more personalized customer experiences.

We are seeking a hands-on Test Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Postman-based API testing and automation. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and maintain scalable API test suites, collaborate closely with backend and DevOps teams, and ensure high-quality, reliable API deliveries across environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the evolution of its infrastructure provisioning and automation ecosystem. This role is ideal for a strategic technical leader who excels in architecting scalable solutions, setting direction, and influencing engineering culture. The Principal Engineer will drive automation, mentor engineers, and collaborate across teams to deliver robust, self-service platform capabilities aligned with the company’s technical vision.

Success requires strong decision-making, the ability to prioritize effectively, and the trust of stakeholders and end users.

* Lead the design and implementation of target state architecture for infrastructure automation, setting standards and patterns for the organization.
* Architect and oversee development of reusable, modular Infrastructure as Code (IaC) components using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Crossplane.
* Define and drive adoption of GitOps driven workflows for automated provisioning, deployment, and lifecycle management of cloud infrastructure.

* Mentor and coach engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

7+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience.

* 5+ years of engineering and support experience on Linux/Unix and Windows servers.

* 5+ years designing and building observability solutions (Splunk, Grafana, Elastic, AppDynamics, Prometheus).
* 3+ years of experience with GitOps principles and tools (ArgoCD, Tekton, GitHub Actions).
* 3+ years of experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs (Golang, Python) and integrating infrastructure automation into platform services.

* Expertise in designing complex, distributed, and scalable enterprise level applications.
* Familiarity with developer portals (e.g., Backstage) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd).
* Exposure to image management tools like Packer or Image Builder.
* Background in building platform engineering solutions supporting cloud-native development and service ownership.
* Strong technical communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* A developer-first mindset with a passion for reducing friction and improving engineering productivity.

This position requires the ability to work in an in-office hybrid environment.

* Understanding of the complexities associated with Microsoft networking requirements, including Entra AD, Intune, and Azure.

* Monitor and optimize device performance, patch management, and user experience.

* Provide Tier 3 support for escalated issues related to Windows 11, Azure Virtual Desktops (AVD), and Intune-managed devices.

* Stay current with Microsoft’s roadmap and best practices for Windows and Intune.

* Document technical procedures, configurations, and standards.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in platform architecture, software development, or enterprise system design.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, IT, or Software Engineering, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows 11, AVD, and Microsoft Endpoint Manager. Additionally, knowledge of OKTA and Zscaler is beneficial.

* Strong knowledge of Group Policy, PowerShell scripting, and Windows security hardening.

* Experience with Autopilot, BitLocker, Defender for Endpoint, and Conditional Access.

* Familiarity with SCCM, Active Directory, and hybrid environments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-500, or AZ-104.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices and Agile methodologies.
* Experience in enterprise environments with 10,000+ endpoints.

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Passion for continuous learning and innovation.  

**Location**

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

**Our mission**

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

  

**Our commitment to you**

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:

**Financial wellness**
  
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.

**Physical wellness**
  
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.

**Personal wellness**
  
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

**How we work**

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Wireless Firmware Engineer
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana, India

Job Type

Full Time

Workspace

Hyderabad, India

**About the Role**
------------------

About the Role  
We are looking for a firmware engineer who understands radios as well as code. You will build firmware for long-range, low-power wireless devices and test tools, from radio drivers and protocol stacks to key storage, over-the-air updates and field validation. You will think in link budgets, timing and security, not just in registers.  
  
You will work directly with the Principal Architect on connected products where reliability in the field, power efficiency and security matter as much as features.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Radio and Protocol Firmware**

* Develop and maintain **LoRa and LoRaWAN** protocol stacks (1.0.x and 1.1): activation, device classes, receive windows, MAC commands, adaptive data rate and regional parameters.
* Apply **spread-spectrum and frequency-hopping radio concepts**, and bring up new radio chipsets and modes behind a clean driver interface.
* Implement robust **retry, acknowledgement and duplicate-handling strategies** for lossy and high-latency links.

#### **Link and RF Engineering**

* Perform **link-budget analysis** and interpret sensitivity, interference and range-test data.
* Account for **frequency stability and timing** (crystal and TCXO choice, drift, offset handling) in radio design and firmware.
* Run **field range and reliability trials**, and turn the results into firmware and configuration improvements.

#### **Security and Key Management**

* Implement AES-128 and AES-CMAC correctly, and manage keys in **protected storage or a secure element**.
* Design **secure device activation and key lifecycle**: provisioning, rotation, revocation, and safe persistence of counters across resets.
* Build **signed over-the-air updates** with a secure boot chain.

#### **Drivers, Gateways and Test**

* Write **SPI radio drivers** and work with gateway-side software (concentrator HALs, packet forwarders and bridges) and timing sources.
* Build **test infrastructure**: Python simulators, hardware-in-the-loop automation, power profiling and instrument-based RF validation.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics, Communications, Embedded Systems or a related field.

#### **Experience:**

* **4–5+ years** of embedded C/C++ on ARM Cortex-M with an RTOS.
* Hands-on wireless protocol work (LoRa/LoRaWAN or a similar low-power wide-area technology), including field debugging.

### **Technical Skills Required**

#### **Embedded Core**

* FreeRTOS or Zephyr, interrupt-driven design, low-power design with measured sleep currents.

#### **Radio and Protocols**

* LoRa PHY parameters (spreading factor, bandwidth, coding rate), LoRaWAN MAC internals, modulation fundamentals, sensitivity and link-budget reasoning.

#### **Security**

* AES-CMAC and AES-CTR, key storage, secure boot, safe counter handling.

#### **Instruments and Tools**

* Spectrum analyser, power profiler, protocol sniffers, logic analyser, JTAG/SWD.

#### **Software Tooling**

* Python, Git and CI.

### **Preferred (Bonus) Skills**

* SDR capture and analysis (IQ recordings, GNU Radio) and DSP fundamentals.
* GNSS and precise timing, or FPGA basics.
* Embedded Rust, and RF certification experience (WPC, ETSI, FCC).

### **Why Join Us**

At **EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD**, we design and deliver connected electronics from idea to deployment. Work on the radio-to-cloud path of real long-range IoT products, with test equipment and field trials, not just simulation. You will see your firmware tested against physics.

### **How to Apply**

Send your updated resume along with links to relevant projects, GitHub or portfolio work to **jobs@eurthtech.com**, or use the application form on this page.

**About the Company**
---------------------

About EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD  
EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD is a cutting-edge Electronics Product Design and Engineering firm specializing in embedded systems, IoT solutions, and high-performance hardware development. We provide end-to-end product development services—from PCB design, firmware development, and system architecture to manufacturing and scalable deployment.  
  
With deep expertise in embedded software, signal processing, AI-driven edge computing, RF communication, and ultra-low-power design, we build next-generation industrial automation, consumer electronics, and smart infrastructure solutions.  
  
Our Core Capabilities  
Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineering – Architecting robust, real-time embedded solutions with RTOS, Linux, and MCU/SoC-based firmware.  
IoT & Wireless Technologies – Developing LoRa, BLE, Wi-Fi, UWB, and 5G-based connected solutions for industrial and smart city applications.  
Hardware & PCB Design – High-performance PCB layout, signal integrity optimization, and design for manufacturing (DFM/DFA).  
Product Prototyping & Manufacturing – Accelerating concept-to-market with rapid prototyping, design validation, and scalable production.  
AI & Edge Computing – Implementing real-time AI/ML on embedded devices for predictive analytics, automation, and security.  
Security & Cryptography – Integrating post-quantum cryptography, secure boot, and encrypted firmware updates.

description:

**About the Role**
------------------

About the Role  
We are looking for a hands-on Embedded Linux engineer to build lean, secure, field-updatable Linux images for ARM-based edge computers, including SoC-plus-FPGA and industrial boards. You will own the path from bootloader to root filesystem, so that images are small, survive power loss, update safely and rebuild reproducibly, even without internet access.  
  
You will work directly with the Principal Architect on long-lifecycle, high-reliability products where memory is tight and every dependency must justify itself.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Platform and Image Engineering**

* Own **Yocto/OpenEmbedded layers** (distro, machine and image recipes) and the build flow (kas or repo).
* Produce **minimal images** (musl/BusyBox or systemd) within strict size, RAM and boot-time budgets, along with a developer SDK.
* Run **offline, reproducible builds** with source and sstate mirrors, vendored dependencies and pinned versions.
* Generate **SBOMs and licence reports**, and enforce licence policy at build time.
* Evaluate OpenWrt or Buildroot where they are the better fit.

#### **Bootloader, Kernel and Drivers**

* Customise **U-Boot** (SPL, FIT images, environment, A/B slot logic) and the **Linux kernel** (minimal configuration, device tree and overlays).
* Write and debug drivers for SPI, UART, I2C, USB, Ethernet, watchdog, RTC, GPIO and pin control.
* Bring up **SoC-plus-FPGA platforms**: programmable-logic device trees, and real-time cores with remoteproc and OpenAMP.
* Tune latency and real-time behaviour, including PREEMPT\_RT where needed.

#### **Update, Security and Resilience**

* Implement **A/B updates with automatic rollback** (RAUC, SWUpdate or Mender) and a **read-only root with overlay**.
* Build a **secure boot chain**: signed images, dm-verity, key handling, and TPM or TrustZone/OP-TEE integration.
* Design **power-fail-safe storage** (ext4, F2FS, UBIFS, SQLite durability) and watchdog and health strategies.
* Design for bit errors and wear: error-correction awareness, integrity checks and recovery.

#### **Quality, Performance and CI**

* Profile boot time and memory (perf, ftrace, bootchart, smem) and add **image-size regression checks**.
* Build CI for images with QEMU and hardware-in-the-loop tests, and write clear runbooks.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Science or a related field.

#### **Experience:**

* **4–5+ years** in embedded Linux, with at least one product shipped on a Yocto-based or similar custom image.
* Hands-on bootloader and kernel work on ARM platforms.

### **Technical Skills Required**

#### **Yocto and Build Systems**

* Layers, bbappend, devtool, SDK generation, sstate and download mirrors, SPDX and licence controls.

#### **Bootloaders and Kernel**

* U-Boot, FIT images and secure boot, device tree, kernel configuration and debugging.

#### **Storage, Update and Security**

* squashfs and overlayfs, dm-verity, RAUC/SWUpdate/Mender, hardened userland.

#### **Hardware and Debug**

* JTAG/SWD, serial consoles, logic analyser, oscilloscope, crash-dump analysis.

#### **Languages and Tooling**

* Strong C, shell and Python; Git and CI; cross-compilation for aarch64 and armv7.

### **Preferred (Bonus) Skills**

* Zynq-class SoC-plus-FPGA work with vendor tooling.
* High-reliability design experience (fault containment, integrity checks, error correction).
* Rust, and familiarity with open-source licences (MIT, Apache, GPL, AGPL).

### **Why Join Us**

At **EURTH TECHTRONICS PVT LTD**, we design and deliver connected electronics from idea to deployment. Build the foundation that real devices boot from. You will work on long-lifecycle products where size, security and recoverability matter, with direct access to a senior architect and real hardware.

title: Architect I - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role description**

Cloud Architect, Codon Platform (AWS and Azure)

Location: UST Hyderabad

Type: Full time, in-house

About the role

Codon is UST's governed developer platform: a web chat and a browser terminal that put Claude to work on ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms, with every write

audited, every secret brokered, and every destination controlled at the network edge. It runs today on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, EFS, internal ALB with blue/green

deployments, a Squid egress tier) with Azure for identity (Entra) and Key Vault, reached over a transit gateway, SD-WAN and Zscaler.

We are hiring the person who owns this architecture end to end and takes it from a single-tenant dev and pilot footprint to a secure, multi-tenant, resilient product. You

will be the technical authority for infrastructure, the counterpart to our network, security, identity and AI gateway teams, and the hands that write the Terraform.

What you will do

Architecture and roadmap

* + Own the target architecture for Codon across AWS and Azure: landing zone, account and subscription structure, network, identity, data, secrets, observability.

* + Design and deliver multi-tenancy: tenant isolation at the account, network, data and identity layers; per-tenant cost attribution; tenant onboarding as code.

* + Design and deliver disaster recovery and business continuity: RPO and RTO targets per tier, cross-region strategy, backup and restore drills, runbooks that are

rehearsed, not written once.

* + Define the environment model (dev, test, pilot, production) and the promotion path between them, including the deployment gate that holds a release until its checks

Security

* + Raise the platform to a documented security posture: least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secret rotation with zero downtime (we already rotate database and gateway

keys), private endpoints, egress allow-listing, encryption and key management (KMS and Key Vault).

* + Run threat modelling for the platform's trust boundaries, including an AI agent with a shell inside a container, and close the findings.

* + Prepare the platform for internal security review and for customer audits (SOC 2 style evidence, logging and retention, access reviews).

Build and operate

* + Write and review the Terraform (modules, environment roots, policy as code). Everything is code; nothing is clicked in a console.

* + Own the CI/CD and release tooling with the product team: image builds, SBOMs, the deployer, evidence capture.

* + Set up observability that answers questions in minutes: central logging, metrics, tracing, ing, cost dashboards.

* + Lead incident analysis across teams. Recent examples from our own log: a rotated database password that silently broke new connections, an egress path that drops for

hours on a shared security gateway, a load balancer whose private addresses changed under a fixed route.

Work with others

* + Be the single technical contact for UST's Network, Cloud, Security, Identity and AI gateway teams; turn their constraints into designs and their requests into tickets

with evidence.

* + Pair with the product engineers daily. Review their infrastructure changes, teach them the platform's rules, and keep the design records current.

* + Guide one or two platform engineers as the team grows.

What you bring

Experience

* + 12 to 14 years in software or infrastructure engineering, of which at least 10 years hands-on in public cloud, with production ownership on both AWS and Azure. Depth on

one, real delivery on the other.

* + You have designed and operated at least one multi-tenant SaaS platform and at least one cross-region DR setup, and you can describe what broke in each.

* + You have written Terraform for years, not months. You can read a plan and tell what will be replaced and why.

Technical

* + AWS: VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, ECS or EKS, RDS, EFS, ALB and NLB, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, Route 53, Organizations and SCPs.

* + Azure: Entra ID (enterprise apps, SAML and OIDC, conditional access), Key Vault with private endpoints, VNets and Private Link, Azure Policy, hybrid connectivity.

* + Networking: routing across cloud and on-premises, SD-WAN and security gateways such as Zscaler, TLS and certificate lifecycle, DNS split-horizon.

* + Security: zero trust principles, workload identity, secret rotation, container hardening, audit logging, compliance evidence.

* + Containers and delivery: Docker, Fargate or Kubernetes, blue/green and canary deployments, GitHub Actions or equivalent, SBOM and vulnerability management.

* + Comfortable reading application code (TypeScript or Python) well enough to find where an infrastructure assumption lives.

Ways of working

* + You write things down: decision records, runbooks, incident reports with evidence. You prefer a diagram and a table to a meeting.

* + You test in production-like conditions and rehearse failures before they happen.

title: O+O Engineering lead
description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!
  
  
Who Are We?
  
  
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  
Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  
Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  
A Day in the Life of O+O Engineering lead!
  
  
We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Engineering Lead to join the L'Oréal Hyderabad Tech Hub. In this strategic role, you will act as the key technical bridge between our global O+O CTO organization in Paris and the delivery teams in Hyderabad, while animating the platform engineering teams across zones in ITH.
  
  
Your core mission will be to contribute to, roll out, and drive the adoption of existing or in-progress O+O standards, platforms, and AISDLC …
  
  
You will collaborate closely with global teams to ensure successful implementation, continuous improvement, and local alignment.
  
  
Beyond driving these rollouts, you will be a hands-on leader responsible for building, recruiting, and mentoring a high-performing team (DevOps, Developers, and Engineers) based in Hyderabad to execute this transformation at scale.
  
  
In this role, You will..
  
  
**Be responsible for the following:**  
As O+O ITH Engineering lead, you will lead the software execution layer of our Beauty Tech and Online & OmniSales ambition for the programs delivered in India Tech Hub. Your role will be to turn project visions into robust, secure, scalable applications & platforms that can be activated globally by our brands, markets, and partners. You will directly contribute to accelerating our insourcing strategy, strengthening our engineering excellence, and building sustainable systems capable of supporting omnichannel, personalized experiences with strong business impact.
  
  
You will lead the implementation of the platform engineering spirit, tooling and patterns into our ITH squads, in alignment with our Global CTO technological strategy.
  
  
**In this position your main mission will be:**  

* Engineering mission and leadership:
* Contribute to the engineering vision in line with the Group’s business and technology strategy, and lead its implementation through a distributed, multicultural organization.
* As well as to the continuous improvement, deployment, and local enforcement of standardized delivery processes, tools, and best practices across all O+O (Online + Offline) programs.
* Platform Engineering:
* Drive the adoption and scaling of the AI SDLC framework within ITH, integrating AI-driven tools and automation across software development phases in alignment with global guidelines.
* Support innovation by leveraging generative AI and machine learning capabilities provided by global platforms to accelerate delivery cycles and improve code quality.
* Deploy Group solutions for End-to-end observability & Smart Ops
* Drive the roll-out, adoption, and local improvements of existing global platforms (such as the IDP - Internal Developer Portal ) for tracking and analyzing Value Creation.
* Architecture and industrialization:
* Contribute to architecture choices and engineering standards to ensure performance, resilience, security, scalability, and maintainability in modern, distributed cloud environments.
* Be the Gatekeeper for architectural decisions & tracking in partnership with the Global CTO team
* End-to-end delivery:
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from design to production release, accelerating the transformation of ideas, AI use cases, and product innovations into solutions deployed at scale.
* Monitor key engineering metrics, team velocity, and delivery efficiency using standard tooling, providing transparent insights to leadership in both Hyderabad and Paris.
* Transformation through GenAI: Make GenAI a concrete lever for engineering productivity and quality by scaling development copilots, test automation, documentation assistance, assisted refactoring, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices.
* Operational excellence: Strengthen DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure fast, safe, frequent deployments and a high level of availability for critical services.
* Culture and talent: Build a demanding engineering culture based on clarity, ownership, simplicity, and impact, while attracting, developing, and retaining technical talent as part of an insourcing and team scale-up strategy.
* Cross-functional partnership:
* Act as a strategic partner to Product, Architecture, Data, Design, and application domain teams to turn business needs into clear, well-arbitrated technical decisions that create value for brands and markets.
* Ensure seamless collaboration and alignment between local delivery execution in Hyderabad and global architectural standards defined by the O+O CTO team in Paris.

What are we looking for?
  

* Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or delivery management role within a matrix organization.
* Tech Skills
* Proficiency in GCP and Azure environments with ability to design & implement cloud native architectures
* Good knowledge of web development technologies & architectures (React, Vue, Node )
* DevSecOps : ability to design end-to-end CICD pipelines : tests, build, security audit (Checkmarx ), code quality audit (SonarQube ), Infra as Code ( Terraform )
* Vector, Hybrid and Graph RAG and their usual databases (Pinecone, Neo4j, TigerDB, GraphDB, PostgreSQL+pgvector). Re-ranking strategies, retrieval pipelines, Hybrid Symbolic & Neural systems
* Tool calling, agent orchestration ( LangGraph / Langchain / Langsmith, MCP / MCP-UI, DSPy, A2A, A2UI)
* Data Engineering (Delta Architectures, Lambda Architectures, Medaillon pattern, BigQuery, Databricks Lakehouse, Dagster / Airflow / Prefect)
* MLOps (VertexAI, MLFlow)
* Leadership style
* Ability to navigate a matrix organization, influence and collaborate with peers (Marketing, Product, Design, Advanced Engineering)
* Calm, clear, and demanding - in the best sense
* Able to simplify without being simplistic
* Respected by senior engineers and product leaders
* Comfortable making and explaining hard trade-offs
* Mindset
* You believe that simple systems are hard to build, but worth it
* You optimize for long-term leverage, not short-term heroics
* You care deeply about craft, but even more about impact
* Collaborative, structured, results-oriented, and adaptable.
* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent English communication skills; capable of navigating a matrix organization with dual reporting lines between local management (India) and global leadership (Paris).

What’s In It for You?
  
  

* Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future-ready careers.
* A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup.
* Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive.
* Holistic wellbeing offerings - personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best.
* Reward and Recognition opportunities, long-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L’Oréal’s collective success.
* L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment

We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.

* Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data-informed adjustments based on telemetry and feedback.
* Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade-offs in simple, direct language.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, streamline delivery processes, and drive measurable business value. Commitment to continuous learning and adoption of new digital capabilities is required.
* Proven success operating within large, matrixed consulting organizations and navigating the scale, complexity, governance, and pace of a Global System Integrator (GSI) environment. Ability to manage competing priorities, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and consistently deliver results in a fast-paced, performance-driven setting.

***Mentorship and Team Development***

* Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads, building their design skills, architectural judgment, and ability to work effectively across systems and teams.

* Growth and Innovation

* Intentionally builds relationship networks within client accounts to deepen partnership and identify opportunities to provide additional business value.
* Partner with sales and account leaders on strategic pursuits by setting the technical vision, contributing to solution strategy, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap sessions.

* Build and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, runbooks, workshops, starter repositories, and templates—that become standard paths for delivery teams.
* Champion adoption of modern frameworks, patterns, platform capabilities, automation, and AI-assisted tools that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a safe and secure way.
* Actively participate in enablement initiatives, share lessons from complex engagements, and help build a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.

***Requirements***

* 10+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary technical domain.
* 5+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams, including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts.
* Deep expertise across most of the following:
* Agents & Orchestration – leveraging Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar frameworks to design intelligent workflows; applying tool/function calling, planner and agent-based patterns, and workflow automation engines.

* Data Integration & Governance – developing and managing data pipelines; applying quality controls, metadata practices, and master data management approaches.
* Analytics & Visualization – delivering insights with Power BI and other visualization tools.
* Proficiency with modern development tools (e.g., GitHub, Copilot, Cursor).

* Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based solutions such as modernizations, transformations, or platform build-outs.
* Ability to define solution architectures that connect business goals to scalable technical designs and solid delivery practices.
* Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable delivery across time zones.
* Deep knowledge of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in your primary domain, with the ability to apply them at program scale.
* Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into solutions using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services.
* Experience with Agile or Scrum at scale, including backlog management, work slicing, and dependency handling.

* Demonstrated interest in learning new cloud technologies and turning that learning into practical improvements for teams.
* Ability to stay hands-on with architecture and, when needed, implementation while guiding complex cloud solutions across teams.

**About the Company**

  

Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.

**About the Role:**

As an AI Solutions Expert/Specialist, you will own the design, development, and deployment of artificial intelligence solutions that automate and optimize the end-to-end content lifecycle across a global CPG organization. You will work at the intersection of AI engineering and content operations — connecting proofs of concept, MVPs, and enterprise-grade platforms to streamline how content is generated, organized, and delivered across every consumer and professional touchpoint.

* Mentor developers and engineers on AI/ML engineering patterns, cloud-native development, and Azure best practices

* 8+ years of experience in software/application development, with a significant portion focused on AI/ML solution engineering

* Hands-on expertise with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI Service, and Azure Cognitive/AI Services

* Strong application development background — ability to build, ship, and maintain production-grade software, not just prototypes or notebooks

* Proven experience with LLMs including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic architectures

* Experience with generative AI for image, video, and/or multi-modal content creation

* Solid experience designing and operating data pipelines in Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Event Grid, or equivalent)

* Proficiency in Python and at least one additional enterprise language (C#, TypeScript, Java)

* Strong understanding of API design, microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS), and cloud-native patterns

* Experience deploying AI solutions through the full maturity curve: POC MVP enterprise production

* Hands-on experience with DevOps and MLOps tooling — Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, MLflow, model versioning, drift monitoring, automated retraining, and A/B testing in production

* Working knowledge of database technologies including Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, and data lake architectures (Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, Azure Synapse)

* Familiarity with front-end and full-stack patterns (React or Angular, FastAPI/Flask backends, serverless architectures) to deliver end-to-end solutions.

**Required Technical Skills:**

**Cloud & AI Platform**

Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure Bot Service

Data Engineering

Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Event Hub / Event Grid, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Data Lake

LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX

**Generative AI**

Deep Agents, Agentic Workflow developments, multi-modal pipelines

Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes / AKS, MLflow, Weights & Biases, model registry, CI/CD for ML

**App Development**

REST / GraphQL APIs, React or Angular, FastAPI / Flask, microservices, serverless, event-driven architectures

**Security & Governance**

Azure RBAC, Key Vault, Managed Identity, responsible AI tooling, content safety APIs

**General Business**

Good to Have — Domain & Business Experience.

* Experience working in or with CPG, FMCG, consumer health, or pharmaceutical organizations

* Familiarity with consumer advertising and media production workflows (TV, digital, social, programmatic)

* Exposure to social media content operations, scheduling platforms, and performance analytics

* Understanding of e-commerce product content (product descriptions, A+ content, marketplace listings)

* Awareness of email marketing and CRM-driven personalization tools (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or similar)

* Experience with HCP and medical affairs communications in regulated environments

* Familiarity with point-of-sale and in-store activation material production

* Experience with PIM and DAM platforms (Salsify, Akeneo, Adobe AEM, Bynder, or similar)

What You’ll Impact.

* Brand consistency and regulatory compliance across all consumer and professional touchpoints

* Data-driven decision-making through AI-powered content insights and performance analytics

* AI agentic automation and process efficiency gains

* The organization’s long-term AI and content technology roadmap

  
  

**Why us?**  
  
At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
