title: Specialist, Databricks Platform Engineer
description:
Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
Our Technology Canters are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Databricks Platform Engineer to support the administration, operation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of our enterprise Databricks platform.
  
The ideal candidate will have experience with Databricks administration, data engineering concepts, platform observability, and technical troubleshooting. This individual will work closely with platform teams, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and other technical users to maintain a reliable platform and help diagnose issues related to jobs, pipelines, compute, access, performance, and user environments.
  
  
The role is well suited for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working directly with users, learning new technologies, and experimenting with new Databricks capabilities.
  
  
What will you do in this role
  
  
Databricks Administration Platform Operations
  
  

* Support day-to-day administration and operation of Databricks environments.
* Manage workspaces, compute resources, clusters, SQL Warehouses, jobs/workflows, libraries, and workspace configurations.
* Support user provisioning, permissions, access controls, service principals, and Unity Catalog.
* Monitor platform health, workload performance, utilization, and operational issues.
* Investigate platform and workload failures using logs, job history, compute metrics, and other diagnostic information.
* Help identify whether issues originate from compute, configuration, permissions, data, application code, or other dependencies.
* Assist with platform upgrades, configuration changes, and operational improvements.
* Maintain platform documentation, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures.

Data Engineering Workload Support
  
  

* Support data engineering workloads running on Databricks using Spark, PySpark, Python, SQL, Delta Lake, and Databricks Jobs/Workflows.
* Assist teams in troubleshooting failed or poorly performing data pipelines.
* Review job failures, logs, Spark execution behavior, compute utilization, data issues, and dependencies to help identify root causes.
* Work with Data Engineers to troubleshoot ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and processing issues.
* Assist with identifying performance bottlenecks and opportunities to improve workload reliability and efficiency.
* Understand basic Data Lake and Lakehouse architecture concepts and how they relate to Databricks workloads.

Platform Observability Reliability
  
  

* Monitor the health and reliability of Databricks workloads and platform services.
* Help develop and maintain monitoring and dashboards for:
* Job and pipeline failures
* Compute utilization
* Workload performance
* Platform health
* Capacity and usage
* Cost and consumption
* Assist in configuring alerts and identifying recurring failure patterns.
* Participate in troubleshooting incidents and root-cause analysis.
* Help translate recurring incidents into opportunities for automation and platform improvements.
* Work with enterprise monitoring solutions such as CloudWatch, Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or similar technologies.

User Support Troubleshooting
  
  

* Work directly with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, analysts, and other Databricks users to understand and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Support problems involving notebooks, jobs, libraries, compute, permissions, data access, Python/SQL environments, and Spark workloads.
* Guide users through appropriate troubleshooting steps and escalate complex platform issues when needed.
* Document common issues and develop reusable knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Communicate technical issues clearly to both platform teams and end users.
* Provide a positive and collaborative support experience rather than simply routing support tickets.

Data Science AI Enablement
  
  

* Support Databricks environments used by Data Science and analytics teams.
* Understand common Data Science workflows involving Python, SQL, notebooks, Spark, MLflow, and machine learning libraries.
* Assist Data Scientists with environment, library, compute, permissions, and data access issues.
* Support the configuration and operation of compute environments used for Data Science and ML workloads.
* Develop working knowledge of emerging AI/ML capabilities available within the Databricks ecosystem.

Technology Exploration Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Stay informed about new Databricks features, runtimes, administrative capabilities, and platform improvements.
* Experiment with relevant new capabilities in development or test environments.
* Participate in small proofs-of-concept to understand how new features could improve reliability, observability, cost, security, or user experience.
* Share findings with the broader platform team.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive platform administration and support activities.
* Continuously improve technical skills across Databricks, cloud, Data Engineering, and Data Science technologies.

What should you have
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Administration, or Cloud Data Platforms.
* Experience withUnity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks Jobs/Workflows, and SQL Warehouses.
* 1-2 years of hands-on Databricks administration experience.
* Experience working with Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms.
* Understanding of Databricks administration and platform operations.
* Working knowledge of Python and SQL.
* Familiarity with Apache Spark / PySpark and distributed data-processing concepts.
* Understanding of Data Engineering and ETL/ELT concepts.
* Experience troubleshooting technical issues using logs, monitoring information, and application/platform diagnostics.
* Familiarity with cloud environments, preferably AWS.
* Understanding of access management, security, and data governance concepts.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical users and work collaboratively to investigate issues.
* Familiarity withGit, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps practices.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code technologies such asTerraform.
* Exposure to Data Science or AI/ML workloads.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies.

Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
  

* Databricks certification or related training.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such asCloudWatch, Splunk, Datadog, or Grafana.
* Familiarity withMLflow, machine learning workflows, or MLOps concepts.
* Experience supporting enterprise data platforms or scientific computing environments

Who we are
  
  
We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
What we look for
  
  
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

description:
**Data Engineering Manager – Product Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**

**About the Role**

Are you an experienced Data Engineer who has led the development of world-class software or digital products? Are you looking for an opportunity to expand your scope and lead products used by some of the biggest and most influential businesses around the world? If the answer to these questions is yes, we would like to talk with you.

ConvergeCONSUMER™ is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world’s largest professional services firm.

We drive value for our clients by optimizing decisions and actions at a level of granularity only made possible with today’s data and technology. ConvergeCONSUMER’s suite of solutions helps consumer-facing businesses prosper in a world being re-shaped by convergence, where the lines between industries, competitors and collaborators, consumers and suppliers, and even human and artificial intelligence have blurred. Our approach for addressing this complexity is simple: we combine Deloitte’s next-generation technology platforms with decades of experience in the consumer sector and a deep understanding of its unique issues and challenges to drive profitability and future growth for our clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our team. This role requires both technical fluency in data engineering and an analytical mindset capable of assessing data quality and real-world representativeness. The primary focus of this role is to establish expertise on our library of vendor licensed datasets, perform data pulls to extract insights from the datasets, link and join across datasets, assess the datasets and delivered insights for their validity and believability, and enable downstream data users, including account and product teams, to correctly leverage the data according to their project needs. The ideal candidate will have exceptional SQL and Python skills, expertise in Google BigQuery and PostgreSQL, and ability to convey complex data, concepts, and ideas in succinct, clear fashion to various business stakeholders. Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset is preferred.

* Work with Product Managers/Owners to understand how products can be used and should be implemented to solve client problems.

* Work with Project Managers to understand client requirements and brainstorm on solutions, implement the assets/products as applicable. Perform exploratory data analysis on large datasets (several GB to TB) to define analytical models and convert them into Model Ready Datasets (MRD)

* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand analysis requirements and deliver solutions.

* Guide teams to perform exploratory analyses to assess new datasets, identify anomalies, and evaluate representativeness of real-world populations or behaviors across multiple engagements

* Build, test, validate and demonstrate analytical models through various relevant error metrics and calibration techniques. Present the forecasting accuracy results to the client team.

* Partner with external vendors to troubleshoot discrepancies, clarify data definitions, and improve feed quality.

* Ensure compliance with internal governance standards and data-sharing agreements.

* Serve as a subject matter expert on external datasets, helping teams interpret and leverage them effectively for analysis and product development.

* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.

* Use version control tools like GitHub to manage code changes and collaborate with the team

* Support and coach your team on best solutioning practices, development tools, and pathfinding and surveys for technologies

* Set technical direction, coach talent, enforce standards, align product/engineering/ops, and manage engagement risks

* Deploy advanced use of both SQL and Python coding languages in analyzing large data sets

**Reporting Relationships**

Reports to the AVP – Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE) and works at the intersection of data, product, and client delivery. Partners with US-based product and portfolio leaders to translate client needs into scalable data solutions, leveraging and validating complex datasets to generate actionable insights. Collaborates with Product, GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting teams across India and the US.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 10-14 years of relevant consulting experience (or equivalent) with a focus on storytelling and building Model Ready Datasets (MRD) based on analysis of large external and client data sets

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field

* Work with Product Managers/Owners to understand how products can be used and should be implemented to solve client problems.

* Work with Project Managers to understand client requirements and brainstorm on solutions, implement the assets/products as applicable. Perform exploratory data analysis on large datasets (several GB to TB) to define analytical models

* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand analysis requirements and deliver solutions.

* Guide teams to perform exploratory analyses to assess new datasets, identify anomalies, and evaluate representativeness of real-world populations or behaviors across multiple engagements

* Build, test, validate and demonstrate analytical models through various relevant error metrics and calibration techniques. Present the forecasting accuracy results to the client team.

* Partner with external vendors to troubleshoot discrepancies, clarify data definitions, and improve feed quality.

* Ensure compliance with internal governance standards and data-sharing agreements.

* Serve as a subject matter expert on external datasets, helping teams interpret and leverage them effectively for analysis and product development.

* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.

* Use version control tools like GitHub to manage code changes and collaborate with the team

* Support and coach your team on best solutioning practices, development tools, and pathfinding and surveys for technologies

* Set technical direction, coach talent, enforce standards, align product/engineering/ops, and manage engagement risks

* Advanced user of both SQL and Python coding languages with experience in analyzing large data sets

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree in a related field.

* Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset.

* Familiarity with cloud environments and deployment patterns.

* Knowledge of data engineering best practices and methodologies.

* Knowledge of feature engineering and practical experience working with data scientists on enabling production feature engineering pipelines at scale.

* Previous experience in a similar role within a fast-paced development environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Data Quality, EDA, MRD generation & Governance Ownership

* Cross-Functional Collaboration with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and External Vendors

* Vendor & External Dataset Management

* Technical Depth in SQL, Python, and Cloud Data Warehousing (GCP/BigQuery)

* Technical Leadership & Team Coaching

* Clear Communication of Complex Data to Business Stakeholders

**Why This Role Matters**

Product Forward Deployed Engineers bridge deep product and domain expertise with real client problems. They apply data and AI/ML capabilities to deliver scalable solutions, translate client learnings back into the product, and shape how Converge Consumer turns data into better decisions. It’s a hands-on path to becoming a leader at the intersection of product, data, and client impact.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
***Company Overview***  
*AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through* ***AutoRABIT ARM*** *for CI/CD and release management,* ***CodeScan*** *for static code analysis and application security,* ***Vault*** *for data backup and recovery, and* ***Guard*** *for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance.* ***AutoRABIT official website***  
  
*Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development.* ***AutoRABIT platform overview***  
  
***Job Role***  
*Own the technical direction and delivery outcomes of a major product area or substantial cross-team initiative. This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining deep engineering ability with customer understanding and product judgment. You will shape solutions with Product and Engineering, implement critical components and remain accountable for how they perform after release.*  
  
***Key Responsibilities***

* ***Product and technical direction.*** *Understand customer workflows, adoption barriers and relevant market alternatives with Product and customer-facing teams. Develop evidence-based recommendations on what to improve, simplify or avoid building. Translate agreed priorities into architecture, delivery increments and measurable outcomes.*
* ***Hands-on delivery.*** *Lead design, coding, review, testing and rollout of complex Java services and platform capabilities. Build critical components and reference implementations. Make trade-offs explicit and help teams deliver secure, maintainable software rather than leaving execution at the design stage.*
* ***Production AI judgment.*** *Develop AI-enabled capabilities where they offer meaningful customer value. Define evaluation cases, security boundaries, human approvals where needed, failure handling and acceptable cost and latency. Select conventional engineering approaches when they solve the problem more reliably.*
* ***Reliability and modernisation.*** *Improve performance, scalability, observability, security and tenant isolation within the assigned scope. Address technical debt through staged investments linked to customer or delivery impact. Resolve systemic causes of production problems and improve prevention.*
* ***Cross-team influence.*** *Align interfaces, dependencies and engineering practices across participating teams. Mentor senior engineers and explain decisions clearly. Partner with Product on priorities, Engineering Managers on delivery capacity and the Distinguished Engineer or CTO on company-wide architecture. Document decision ownership and escalate unresolved cross-product trade-offs.*
* *Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.*

***Pride of Ownership***  
*We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes.*  
  
***Experience & Desired Skills***  
***Required Skills (Mandatory)***

* *12+ years delivering enterprise software, with demonstrated Principal-level ownership of significant initiatives; scope and outcomes carry more weight than tenure alone.*
* *Deep hands-on Java, Spring Boot, API, microservices and distributed-systems expertise.*
* *Strong enterprise SaaS engineering experience, including security, performance and operational reliability.*
* *Practical AWS or Azure architecture, containers, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD experience.*
* *Experience delivering AI-enabled software or developer productivity capabilities into production and evaluating their effectiveness.*
* *Practical familiarity with relevant AI approaches such as LLMs, RAG, agents or MCP; sound engineering judgment matters more than a particular framework.*
* *Evidence of influencing product decisions, leading cross-team implementation and mentoring senior contributors.*
* *Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders across regions.*

***Preferred Skills (Good to Have)***

* *Salesforce metadata, APIs or release workflows; DevSecOps, CI/CD, data protection or developer-tool products.*
* *Modernisation of complex enterprise platforms and work in regulated or security-sensitive settings.*
* *Significant proprietary product achievements, open-source contributions, publications or patents demonstrating technical influence.*

***What success looks like***

* *Within 90 days, understand the assigned product area, agree outcome measures and identify its most consequential technical constraints.*
* *Within six months, deliver agreed milestones for a substantial initiative and demonstrate improvement against its baseline.*
* *Build durable capability in the team through reusable components, documented decisions and mentoring.*

***Why join AutoRABIT***  
*You will shape important product decisions while remaining close to implementation. This role offers ownership of meaningful customer outcomes and the opportunity to strengthen the technical foundations of AutoRABIT products.*  
  
***Experience:*** *12+ Years*  
***Compensation:*** *75 - 90 Lakhs per annum*  
***Location:*** *Hyderabad*

title: Tech Architect
description:
**Position Details**

* Department: Engineering / Technology
* Reports to: VP of Engineering / CTO
* Location: Hyderabad, India
* Work arrangement: In-office only
* Employment type: Full-time

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Tech Architect to define and drive the technical direction of our SaaS platform. You will architect and build scalable backend web services; design analytics pipelines for drone-captured images and videos; enable enterprise-grade single sign-on (SSO) and a secure, extensible integration layer; and turn proofs of concept (POCs) and prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems. You will also champion AI/LLM-powered agentic coding to improve engineering productivity, while setting high standards for security, quality, scalability, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define end-to-end architecture for a multi-tenant SaaS platform, balancing scalability, performance, security, availability, and cost.
* Assess existing POC and prototype code, determine what can be reused versus re-architected, and define a practical path to production and go-live.
* Production-harden prototypes through robust error handling, logging, monitoring, automated testing, security controls, configuration management, and performance tuning.
* Own production-readiness reviews, load and performance testing, CI/CD and deployment strategies (including blue-green and canary releases), rollback plans, and post-launch support.
* Architect scalable analytics pipelines for drone-captured imagery and video, covering live-stream and bulk-field-upload ingestion, processing, model inference, storage, and API-based delivery of results.
* Address drone-data constraints, including large high-resolution media, intermittent or low-bandwidth connectivity, GPS and flight telemetry, altitude, gimbal/camera orientation, timestamps, and mapping data to missions, sites, and assets.
* Make architecture decisions for real-time versus batch processing, GPU/accelerator utilization, edge versus cloud inference, and cost optimization for media-heavy workloads.
* Architect enterprise identity and SSO using SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0; support per-tenant SSO configuration, integrations with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and session management.
* Design and own the platform’s extensibility and integration layer, including public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension models for customer, partner, third-party, drone-platform, and fleet-management integrations, with versioning, backward compatibility, and safe sandboxing.
* Own end-to-end security architecture, including API gateway and WAF controls, authentication and authorization, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets and key management, audit logging, and tenant data isolation.
* Drive secure-by-design practices through threat modelling, security reviews of designs and code, dependency and vulnerability management, and penetration-test remediation—including for AI-generated code and third-party extensions/integrations.
* Architect and oversee backend services, including REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and service-to-service communication.
* Remain hands-on: write and review production-grade backend code, build POCs, and demonstrate engineering standards by example.
* Design core SaaS capabilities such as multi-tenancy, subscription and billing integration, tenant data isolation, rate limiting, and horizontal scalability.
* Lead adoption of AI/LLM agentic coding tools such as Claude Code for delivery acceleration, refactoring, and productionizing prototype code.
* Establish workflows and best practices for AI-assisted software development, including code-review standards, guardrails, and quality gates for AI-generated code.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Define technical standards, coding guidelines, and architectural patterns across engineering teams; evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, tools, and emerging AI/LLM and computer-vision capabilities.
* Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Review and approve high-level designs (HLDs), guide low-level designs (LLDs), identify technical debt, and lead legacy-system modernization, using AI-assisted tools where beneficial.
* Ensure architecture meets non-functional requirements for scalability, availability, security, tenant isolation, and observability.
* Mentor senior engineers and tech leads on architecture, productionizing prototypes, and effective use of AI coding assistants.
* Lead POCs for new technologies, LLM/agentic workflows, vision models, and major system changes.
* Collaborate with DevOps/SRE teams on infrastructure, deployment, and CI/CD architecture.
* Own architecture documentation and keep it current across the organization.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in architecture-focused roles.
* Proven experience building and scaling SaaS products end to end, ideally from early-stage development through growth.
* A demonstrated track record of taking POCs/prototypes to production through refactoring, re-architecture, hardening, and successful live launches with measurable reliability and performance.
* Strong backend engineering experience designing, building, and scaling production REST/GraphQL APIs and microservices.
* Experience designing or building systems that ingest and process drone-generated aerial imagery and video at scale, including use cases such as object detection, change detection, classification, tracking, and inspection.
* Understanding of video streaming protocols (RTSP, RTMP, WebRTC, HLS), encoding/transcoding, and large-scale media storage.
* Experience with drone data and metadata, including geo-tagged imagery, flight telemetry, geospatial context, and data flows from device or ground station to cloud.
* Familiarity with production deployment and serving of computer-vision/ML models, including inference optimization, GPU workloads, batching, and model versioning; exposure to OpenCV, FFmpeg, or similar frameworks.
* Hands-on experience implementing enterprise SSO and authentication using SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, and SCIM in multi-tenant SaaS products, including integration with major identity providers.
* Experience designing extensible platforms with public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension or third-party integration frameworks, including versioning, rate limiting, and safe extension isolation.
* Strong security architecture skills covering API security, encryption, secrets management, tenant isolation, secure SDLC, threat modelling, and OWASP Top 10 risks and mitigations.
* Mandatory hands-on coding capability; this is an active engineering role, not solely an architecture-review position.
* Practical, demonstrable use of AI/LLM-based agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) in real engineering workflows, beyond casual use.
* Strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, and microservices architecture.
* Experience with multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing systems, and SaaS scalability patterns.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including managed GPU/ML and media services.
* Deep proficiency in at least one major backend language/stack: Java, Python, Node.js, .NET, or Go.
* Deep understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, data modelling, caching strategies (Redis or Memcached), and object storage.
* Strong experience with API design, API gateways, messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, and service-integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and production observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
* Understanding of LLM fundamentals—prompting, context management, tool/function calling, RAG, agentic workflows, and multimodal models—sufficient to architect responsible AI integrations.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Working knowledge of compliance and data-control frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR, including privacy and data-retention considerations for aerial imagery and video. Regulated-industry experience is a plus, not mandatory.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading architecture reviews and building consensus across engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with drone SDKs/platforms such as DJI, MAVLink, PX4, or ArduPilot, or with drone fleet and mission-management software.
* Experience with geospatial and photogrammetry tooling, including GIS, orthomosaics, 3D reconstruction, GDAL, or PostGIS.
* Experience with edge/on-device inference or low-latency real-time video processing at a ground station or on a drone.
* Experience with video analytics platforms or stream-processing frameworks such as GStreamer, NVIDIA DeepStream, or Triton Inference Server.
* Experience building a developer ecosystem or marketplace, including partner APIs, app/extension marketplaces, and developer portals.
* Experience with zero-trust architecture, mutual TLS (mTLS), WAF/API-gateway policy design, or security tooling such as SAST/DAST and SIEM integrations.
* Experience with API monetization, usage-based billing, or SaaS metering systems.
* Experience building or integrating LLM-powered applications or agents in production.
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent-tooling frameworks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization and orchestration technologies.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Experience with SRE practices, including SLOs/SLAs, incident response, and capacity planning.
* Prior experience scaling SaaS systems from startup to enterprise scale.
* Relevant certifications, such as AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF, or security certifications.

**Role Expectations**

* Be a hands-on technical leader who can move fluidly between architecture, implementation, code review, production readiness, and technical mentoring.
* Balance rapid delivery with long-term maintainability, security, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Build consensus across teams and communicate trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Application note: Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate hands-on backend engineering, productionizing POCs, SaaS architecture, drone-media/data pipeline design, enterprise SSO and security architecture, and practical use of AI-assisted coding tools.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.**

Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.**

Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. * **Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.**

Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.**

description:
### **Summary**

We are seeking a hands-on Cloud Detection Engineer to help shape the future of cloud security monitoring at Novartis. You will design, build, validate and continuously improve detection capabilities across Azure, AWS and other strategic cloud platforms while being a key partner with incident response and cloud security architect teams. An engineering role that combines cloud telemetry, custom detections, threat research, automation and AI-assisted investigation to create high-signal, scalable outcomes for Cyber Defense.
  
  
Role purpose:
  
  
Build a robust, AI-native cloud detection pipeline that improves correlation and investigation efficiency across multi-cloud environments. Engineer fragmented cloud telemetry into clear, actionable security outcomes with AI embedded throughout the detection engineering lifecycle. A multidimensional engineering role at the intersection of automation, cloud architecture, threat behavior analysis, detection engineering supporting analyst investigation workflows.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and operate an AI-native cloud detection pipeline that aggregates, correlates, enriches, deduplicates and prioritizes signals before analyst investigation
* Build and tune high-fidelity detections that improve coverage across cloud control-plane, data plane and management-plane activity, identity and access, network, container and Kubernetes and security posture.
* Use lower-fidelity and behavioral signals as investigation context, while ensuring known high-confidence detections are consistently escalated for security investigation
* Integrate and correlate telemetry from WIZ, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, AWS GuardDuty, Microsoft Sentinel and other cloud-native or CNAPP sources . Apply hands-on Wiz experience to interpret posture findings, attack paths, identity and exposure context, cloud events, runtime findings and threat detections and improve detection workflows
* Develop behavioral baselines and entity-centric analytics across users, IP addresses, identities and cloud resources . Create reusable dashboards, dynamic lookups and enrichment patterns enabling rapid pivots / drilldowns from an alert to related resource, identity, inventory and historical data
* Own the detection lifecycle from threat hypothesis and telemetry assessment through development, peer review, testing, deployment, tuning, documentation and retirement
* Embed AI across the detection lifecycle to accelerate detection creation and tuning, while ensuring engineering controls and human judgment govern the outcomes
* Finetune detections using historical data, controlled simulations, purple-team exercises, attack emulation and lessons learned from incidents and threat hunts
* Use detection-as-code practices, Git, CI/CD and automated testing to deliver controlled, repeatable and auditable content changes . Partner with Threat Hunting and Response, CSOC analysts, cloud platform teams, data onboarding, threat intelligence and automation teams to close visibility gaps and operationalize detections
Automate enrichment and triage using Python, APIs, SOAR workflows and AI-assisted approaches, with appropriate human oversight for security decisions . Measure and improve detection coverage, precision, false-positive rate, investigation volume, alert latency, data quality and analyst effort  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in cloud security, detection engineering, security analytics, threat hunting, incident response or security platform engineering
* Working knowledge of Azure and AWS security architectures, respective cloud domains and workloads
* Understanding of cloud telemetry and logging sources such as Azure Activity and Diagnostic logs, Entra ID logs, AWS CloudTrail, AWS CloudWatch and GuardDuty findings
* Experience in working with CNAPP bundles or developing and tuning detections in Wiz, Vega or cloud-native security platforms
* Proficiency in KQL and at least one scripting or programming language such as Python. CloudShell understanding is expected
* Familiarity with AI/LLM-assisted security investigation, agentic workflows or machine-learning approaches to signal enrichment and triage . Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, threat-informed defense, entity mapping, correlation, enrichment and alert prioritization
* Ability to investigate complex datasets, distinguish true security risk from operational noise and communicate engineering decisions clearly . Experience collaborating across security operations, cloud engineering and platform teams in a global environment.
Experience with detection-as-code, Sigma or YAML-based content, Git, CI/CD, unit/integration testing and safe deployment or rollback practices . Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation or equivalent. Background in threat intelligence, purple teaming, red teaming, incident response or cloud threat research  

**Desirable Requirement:**

  
  

* Relevant certifications such as AZ-500, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, GIAC Cloud Security certifications, CCSP or equivalent practical expertise.
* GIAC Cloud Forensics Responder (GCFR)

title: AI Engineer (Generative AI / MLOps / AI Agents)
description:
**Req ID:** 386620
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a AI Engineer (Generative AI / MLOps / AI Agents) to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
We are seeking a skilled and motivated AI Engineer (Mid-Level) to join contract basis. This role sits at the intersection of Generative AI, MLOps, and Intelligent Agent development — and is responsible for designing, building, and deploying AI-powered solutions that directly support our PC insurance operations.
  
  
You will work closely with our data engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver LLM-powered applications, automated AI agents, and production-ready ML pipelines across claims, underwriting, and actuarial domains. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role for an engineer who is comfortable moving from architecture whiteboard to working code.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Generative AI LLM Engineering
  

* Design, fine-tune, and deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) for insurance-specific use cases including document intelligence, claims summarization, policy interpretation, and underwriting QA.
* Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, Pinecone, ChromaDB) to ground LLM outputs in enterprise knowledge bases.
* Develop prompt engineering frameworks and systematic evaluation pipelines to ensure LLM output quality, consistency, and safety in regulated insurance contexts.
* Integrate LLM capabilities with internal data platforms via LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.
* Evaluate and benchmark foundational models (OpenAI GPT-4o, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, Llama) against insurance-specific tasks to guide platform selection.

AI Agents Automation
  

* Architect and implement autonomous AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning, tool use, and decision-making for workflows such as FNOL triage, claims routing, policy lookup, and compliance checks.
* Build agentic frameworks using patterns such as ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, and Tool-Augmented Agents to handle complex, multi-turn insurance workflows.
* Design human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints and escalation logic to ensure AI agents operate within defined risk and compliance boundaries.
* Integrate agents with internal APIs, data platforms, and enterprise systems using orchestration tools such as Azure Logic Apps, Apache Airflow, or Databricks Workflows.
* Develop guardrails, monitoring, and audit logging for all deployed agents to meet regulatory and governance standards.

MLOps Model Deployment
  

* Build and maintain end-to-end MLOps pipelines covering model training, versioning, validation, deployment, and monitoring using MLflow, Azure ML, and Databricks.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, enabling reliable, repeatable model releases.
* Deploy models as REST APIs or batch inference services on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Azure Container Apps, ensuring scalability and low-latency response.
* Establish model monitoring frameworks to detect data drift, model degradation, and prediction anomalies in production.
* Manage the model registry and lineage tracking to maintain governance and auditability of all AI assets.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure feature pipelines are production-grade, versioned, and integrated with the Feature Store on Databricks or Azure ML.

Collaboration Delivery
  

* Work closely with business analysts, actuaries, underwriters, and claims professionals to translate domain requirements into AI solution designs.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives as an active delivery contributor.
* Produce clear, well-structured technical documentation including solution designs, API specs, model cards, and deployment runbooks.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal AI engineering best practices and standards.

Required Qualifications
  
  
Education
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Master's degree is a plus.

Experience
  

* 3–5 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with demonstrated delivery of production-grade AI systems.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.
* Proven experience implementing MLOps pipelines in cloud environments (Azure preferred).
* Experience developing AI agents or automation workflows using agentic frameworks.
* Prior experience in financial services, insurance, or regulated industries is strongly preferred.

Technical Skills
  
  
Generative AI LLMs
  

* OpenAI / Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo), Claude, Mistral, or open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Falcon)
* RAG architectures, vector search, embeddings (OpenAI, Cohere, SentenceTransformers)
* LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel
* Prompt engineering, few-shot learning, instruction tuning, RLHF concepts

AI Agents Automation
  

* Agentic frameworks: ReAct, Tool-Augmented Agents, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI
* Workflow orchestration: Apache Airflow, Databricks Workflows, Azure Logic Apps
* API design and integration: REST, GraphQL, Webhooks

MLOps Model Serving
  

* MLflow (experiment tracking, model registry, model serving)
* Azure Machine Learning, Databricks AutoML Feature Store
* Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Azure Container Apps
* CI/CD: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions
* Model monitoring: Evidently AI, Azure ML monitoring, or equivalent

Programming Data Engineering
  

* Python (expert level): PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy
* PySpark and Delta Lake for large-scale data processing
* SQL (T-SQL / Spark SQL) for feature engineering and data validation
* Git for version control and collaborative development

Cloud Platform

As an AI Security Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.

Work you'll do

As an AI Security Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.

The team

Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.

We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.

Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.

title: R&D Data Management Expert - Data and AI
description:
**At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.**

  

**R&D Data Management Expert - Data and AI**

**Job Posting Title**

R&D Data Management Expert - Data and AI

**Job Description Summary**

Develops, implements, and administers policies and procedures to ensure the quality and protection of organizational data, aligning with strategic priorities and regulatory requirements to minimize risk. Collaborates with leadership to define specific roles and responsibilities related to the organizations data assets, ensuring clarity in data stewardship. Develops and maintains rules and policies governing data management and access restrictions, promoting best practices in data governance. By fostering a culture of compliance and accountability, plays a critical role in safeguarding the organizations data integrity and security.

**PURPOSE**

Insight generation and business process optimization across R&D by ensuring internally generated data as well as externally sourced data are **FAIR+Q** (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable, and of Quality). This is achieved, among other things, through the development and implementation of key data capabilities:

* **Data and AI Catalog:** Central location to find data assets, data models, AI Models, applications and related governance information
* **Business Information Modeling:** Connecting and describing data across domains
* **Reference Data Capability:** Providing standards for use in information models and workflows.
* **Business Data Architecture:** Charting data flow across business processes and systems
* **Master Data Capability:** Maintaining authoritative sources of key business data concepts such as project, product, sites etc. to gain a trusted, current view of these key data

The role will be responsible for the vision and delivery of the Data and AI Cataloging Capability while closely collaborating with Business Information Modeling, Business Data Architecture, Reference Data Standards, and other relevant data and AI capabilities. The domain scope of the role is all of R&D. The Data and AI Catalog expert acts as a business leader in initiatives involving the cataloguing of data, data models, AI models, governance policies and related information to allow humans and AI Agents access to information that is relevant for business workflows. The role collaborates closely with stakeholders across the organization to strengthen discoverability, understanding, ownership, quality, and usage conditions of R&D data assets.

  

**STAKEHOLDERS**

The role will interact and establish strong partnerships with

* + Data producers, consumers, owners and stewards across R&D. These could include lab and computational scientists, clinicians, statisticians, pharmaceutical and regulatory affairs professionals.
  + Data architects, engineers, UI/UX engineers, product/platform/technology teams
  + AI and ML scientists, engineers etc.
  + Vendors and external contract staff
  + Relevant Industry forums / consortia in the data and information space.

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Data and AI Catalog Management (Pharma R&D Focus):Co-create and own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, rollout (resourcing, budgeting and delivery) and adoption (communication and metrics) of an R&D data and AI Model Catalog capability that aligns with the broader goals of the Pharmaceutical R&D team. This includes cross-domain search and discovery capabilities that enable scientists to find relevant data assets and reduce time to insight. Translate data cataloguing into business value by driving alignment between R&D data and AI model Catalog and key R&D business outcomes. Implement and manage specialized R&D data and AI Model catalog/s to maintain an inventory of a vast array of scientific data assets, from raw instrument outputs to curated datasets, data products, data models, AI models and services and governance policies.

* Partner with business and technical teams to create cohesive frameworks for access control, modeling, cross-domain discoverability, reusability for various analytics and AI use cases, and lifecycle management
* Enhance the catalog by ensuring integration with R&D systems, processes and AI services allowing scientists to quickly grasp the meaning, context, and reliability of data. Liaise with IT to troubleshoot technical issues, maintain server integrity, and integrations with other platforms and capabilities.
* Document and manage governance while taking into consideration the purpose and intended use of data, e.g. data sensitivity, privacy, GxP compliance, data lineage and data integrity. This is done in close collaboration with R&D Data Governance, Quality Assurance, Legal, Patents and Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, etc.
* Drive adoption and best practices across teams by providing tailored training on the use of the catalog for specific research needs. Monitor the usage and effectiveness of the data catalog.
* Establish feedback loops to capture unmet data needs and gaps in catalog coverage as well as improve data quality.
* Partner with business and technology teams responsible for business information modeling, business data architecture, master and reference data standards, other data and AI capabilities to enable seamless data operations across R&D

**Strategic Leadership**

* + Influence without authority
  + Operate collaboratively in a flat-hierarchy environment
  + Advocate data capabilities usage across diverse R&D functions.
  + Co-shape DSAI strategy for data and data science

**WHO YOU ARE**

* MS in Biological Sciences or MS Computer Science, Data Science, and Information Management preferably in a biomedical context.
* 10+ years in data catalog, metadata management and controlled vocabularies, related data and search capabilities in the biomedical domain. Product thinking would be a distinct bonus.
* Good understanding of pharmaceutical or life science R&D and the user base.

### **The Opportunity**

When a technician in a refinery, a mine, or a chemical plant opens one of our apps, they are trusting that it works, every time, on a shift where the stakes are real. As a **Staff Engineer**, you are one of the people who earns that trust.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will not manage a team on an org chart. You will lead through the quality of your designs, the depth of your code, and the engineers you make better. You will own the technical direction of major areas of our Mobile and Web platform, set the engineering bar for the teams around you, and turn ambiguous business problems into simple, scalable, dependable solutions.

You will work across our product suite and across the stack, from Node.js microservices and data models to Angular/React and React Native experiences, on AWS. You will also help us bring AI-enabled capabilities into products that frontline workers use every day.

We believe quality depends on the people making the design decisions. At Staff level, you own the "-ilities": scalability, reliability, security, performance, and maintainability. You build them into the design instead of testing them afterwards.

### **How You Will Make An Impact**

* **Own architecture and design.** Lead the design of complex, cross-team features and platform capabilities. Write clear HLDs and LLDs, drive design reviews, and make the trade-offs explicit.
* **Build what matters, hands-on.** Write production-grade code in Node.js, MongoDB/DynamoDB, and Angular or React (including React Native) for the hardest, highest-impact problems. You lead from the code.
* **Design APIs and microservices that last.** Define RESTful and OData API contracts, service boundaries, and data models that scale across customers, industries, and SAP and IBM Maximo integrations.
* **Raise the engineering bar.** Set standards for code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and documentation. Use tools like SonarQube and strong unit and integration testing so that quality is measurable.
* **Be the multiplier.** Mentor Senior Engineers and Leads, grow future architects, and make every design and code review a teaching moment.
* **Drive reliability and performance.** Own the non-functional requirements of your area. Lead root-cause analysis on complex production issues and fix the system, not just the symptom.
* **Deploy with confidence.** Shape how we ship on AWS (and Azure/GCP where needed) with Docker, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices.
* **Partner across the company.** Work closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, UX designers, QE, and Engineering leadership on vision, planning, and high-level estimates. Join customer conversations when a hard problem needs the right answer.
* **Shape our AI-enabled future.** Help integrate AI services into our products responsibly, and bring a pragmatic view of what works in industrial environments.
* **Stay curious.** Evaluate emerging technologies and bring the ones that make our products and our teams better.

**What You Bring to the Team:**

**Key Qualifications**
----------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* **10–12 years** of full stack engineering experience, with a track record of delivering multiple major releases of SaaS products.
* Deep expertise in **Node.js** and **MongoDB / DynamoDB**, including data modelling and performance optimization.
* Strong proficiency in **Angular or React**; experience with **React Native** or mobile (hybrid/native) applications is a strong plus.
* Proven experience designing **RESTful / OData APIs and microservices architectures** at scale.
* Hands-on experience with **AWS** (Azure/GCP a plus), **Docker and Kubernetes**, and setting up or driving **CI/CD**.
* A history of technical leadership: leading designs, mentoring engineers, and influencing without authority.
* A quality mindset: unit testing, code quality tooling (e.g., SonarQube), security, observability, and performance as part of everyday engineering.
* Excellent communication. You can write a crisp design doc (HLD/LLD/SDD) and explain a complex trade-off to an engineer, a product manager, or a customer.
* Experience in an agile environment.
* **Good to have:** integration experience with SAP or IBM Maximo; Realm and AWS Amplify; third-party integrations (Instabug, Mixpanel, payment gateways); exposure to AI/GenAI-enabled product features; background in industrial, ERP, or enterprise SaaS.
* A valid passport, as occasional customer travel may be needed.
* If you meet most of this and are excited by the problem, we encourage you to apply. We hire for ownership and curiosity.

### **Why Join Us**

* Be the **architect of reliability and adoption** for the world’s leading industrial brands.
* Influence how industrial SaaS is designed, delivered, and scaled globally.
* Collaborate with top minds in maintenance, operations, and technology.
* Work in a culture that values **initiative, ownership, and measurable impact**.
* Competitive compensation, performance-linked rewards, and comprehensive benefits.

* Ability to independently investigate complex technical problems, perform root-cause analysis, and collaborate with developers to resolve issues.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, organizational, and prioritization skills.

Software Engineering & Automation

* Experience designing scalable, maintainable, and reusable automation frameworks.

* Experience improving automation stability, execution time, coverage, and reliability.

* RabbitMQ operations.
* Multi-tenant SaaS.

* Speed: Provisioning new environments strictly within the agreed SLA.
* Reliability: Achieving zero deployment failures caused by underlying infrastructure issues.
* Efficiency: Successfully automating at least 1 manual process every month.
* Responsiveness: Acknowledging critical on-call alerts within 15 minutes.
* Knowledge Sharing: Ensuring 100% of critical operational procedures are fully documented in runbooks.

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. title: AI Engineer*
description:
**Description**

  
We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer with deep expertise in building AI Agents from the ground up, designing agentic workflows, and integrating enterprise tooling and MCP servers into production-grade agent systems. The ideal candidate has a builder's mindset someone who has architected and shipped real agents, not just experimented with frameworks. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, workflow automation, and enterprise integration. You will design agents that reason, act, and collaborate across business systems and make them accessible to end users through platforms like Slack

**What You'll Do**

**Agent Development & Architecture**

* Build AI Agents from scratch, including reasoning loops, memory management, tool calling, and state handling
* Design and implement multi-agent systems with defined roles, handoffs, and coordination logic
* Build agent orchestration layers to manage task delegation, agent communication, and failure recovery
* Implement planning and reflection patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, etc.) for autonomous task completion
* Design agents capable of handling long-running, multi-step workflows with human-in-the-loop checkpoints

**MCP Integration**

* Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients from the ground up
* Integrate MCP servers into agent runtimes to expose enterprise tools, APIs, and data sources as callable context
* Design reusable MCP tooling layers that agents can dynamically discover and invoke
* Ensure secure, governed access when agents interact with internal systems via MCP

**Tool & System Integration**

* Integrate agents with enterprise tools including Jira, Salesforce, Slack, Notion, GitHub, ServiceNow, and others
* Build robust tool-calling interfaces, error handling, and retry logic for agent-tool interactions
* Connect agents to internal APIs, databases, and SaaS platforms via structured integration frameworks
* Develop and maintain an internal tool registry accessible by agents at runtime

**Agentic Workflows & Automation**

* Design end-to-end agentic workflows that automate complex, multi-step business processes
* Build automation pipelines that route tasks intelligently across agents, tools, and human reviewers
* Implement event-driven agent triggers integrated with enterprise systems and data streams
* Optimize workflows for reliability, observability, and cost efficiency

**Slack Platform & Agent Accessibility**

* Deploy and expose AI agents as interactive Slack bots and workflow apps
* Build Slack surfaces (slash commands, modals, home tabs, message actions) that connect users to agent capabilities
* Implement conversational agent interfaces in Slack with context retention across threads
* Enable agents to proactively surface insights, alerts, and task updates within Slack channels

**RAG, Data & Knowledge Systems**

* Implement RAG architectures to ground agents in enterprise knowledge bases
* Build vector pipelines, embeddings, and retrieval systems that agents query at runtime
* Integrate Snowflake (Cortex, Snowpark) as a data backbone for agent memory and structured data access

**AI Security & Governance**

* Implement prompt injection defenses, access controls, and data leakage prevention within agent pipelines
* Design RBAC and audit logging for all agent actions and tool invocations
* Ensure agents operate within defined security and compliance boundaries

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of software or AI engineering experience
* Proven experience building AI Agents from the ground up — not just configuring frameworks
* Hands-on experience integrating MCP servers and clients into agent systems
* Experience designing and deploying agentic workflows and multi-step automations
* Experience building and deploying Slack bots or Slack-integrated AI applications
* Strong Python skills with experience in async, event-driven, and API-heavy architectures
* Experience with tool-calling patterns, function routing, and agent-tool error handling
* Solid understanding of LLM behavior, context windows, and prompt engineering
* Experience with RAG architectures and vector databases

* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel
* Experience with Snowflake Cortex or Snowpark for AI workloads
* Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source LLMs
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS)
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Experience with AI observability, tracing, and evaluation frameworks
* Snowflake certifications are a plus

**Technical Skills**

* Agentic AI (from-scratch agent design, orchestration, multi-agent systems)
* MCP (Model Context Protocol) — server and client development
* Tool integration and function calling
* Slack Platform (Bolt SDK, Block Kit, Slack APIs)
* Python (async, REST, event-driven)

title: IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager – R&D Commercialization and PPM
description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-253537 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 13, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems

The IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager is responsible for enabling effective delivery across multiple Digital Product Teams supporting R&D Commercialization and PPM through strong SAFe Agile execution, Release Train leadership, Scrum Master responsibilities, and Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) adoption.

This role serves as a hands-on delivery leader responsible for coordinating cross-product planning and execution, facilitating Agile ceremonies, managing dependencies and risks, improving delivery transparency, and enabling teams to consistently deliver measurable business value.

The role will partner closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and Agile/DPOM enablement partners to establish scalable ways of working across multiple product teams.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**Release Train & Cross-Product Delivery**

* Serve as Release Train Engineer and delivery lead across multiple Digital Product Teams, coordinating integrated planning and execution across the product landscape.
* Establish and facilitate the operating cadence required to coordinate multiple teams, products, dependencies, releases, and shared resources.
* Lead preparation and facilitation of PI Planning, ART synchronization, product-level planning, Inspect & Adapt events, and other cross-team SAFe ceremonies.
* Maintain visibility into cross-team dependencies, risks, impediments, milestones, capacity, and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to translate product roadmaps and business priorities into executable delivery plans.
* Drive resolution of delivery impediments and escalate systemic risks or decisions requiring leadership intervention.
* Coordinate with other Release Train Engineers, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and delivery leaders where work spans ARTs, products, or organizational boundaries.

**Scrum Master & Team Delivery Responsibilities**

* Provide hands-on Scrum Master leadership for product teams as required while maintaining cross-team Release Train responsibilities.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Coach teams on effective backlog management, story readiness, estimation, capacity planning, prioritization, and definition of done.
* Help teams identify and remove impediments that affect delivery, quality, flow, or predictability.
* Promote team ownership, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Adapt Agile practices pragmatically based on team maturity, product needs, and organizational context rather than focusing solely on process compliance.

**Product Operating Model Enablement**

* Support maturation of Amgen's Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) & SAFe Agile frameworks across participating product teams.
* Help translate DPOM & SAFe Agile principles into practical delivery processes, roles, ceremonies, governance, and decision-making mechanisms.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to strengthen the connection between business outcomes, product roadmaps, prioritization, capacity, and technology delivery.
* Help teams evolve from project-oriented execution toward persistent, outcome-oriented digital product delivery.
* Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and operating expectations across Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and delivery roles.
* Partner with enterprise Agile and DPOM enablement teams to align local practices with evolving enterprise standards and strategy.

**Delivery Governance, Metrics & Reporting**

* Establish and maintain consistent Agile delivery practices and JIRA structures across participating product teams.
* Develop delivery reporting that provides Product Owners and leadership with clear visibility into roadmap execution, capacity, progress, dependencies, risks, and impediments.
* Use meaningful delivery and product metrics to assess flow, predictability, quality, throughput, risk, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate regular delivery and program reviews with Product Owners and stakeholders.
* Ensure metrics support decision-making and improvement rather than becoming administrative reporting exercises.
* Support consistent tracking of product roadmap commitments, releases, milestones, and value drops.

**Agile Coaching & Continuous Improvement**

* Coach Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and other stakeholders on effective SAFe, Agile, Lean, and product delivery practices.
* Assess team and Release Train maturity and identify practical opportunities to improve planning, execution, flow, collaboration, and predictability.
* Develop and promote reusable delivery practices, templates, playbooks, and standards that can scale across product teams.
* Foster shared learning and consistency while allowing teams flexibility based on product and delivery needs.
* Encourage experimentation and iterative improvement of the delivery operating model.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Build strong working relationships with Product Owners, Product Management, business stakeholders, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, and enterprise enablement partners.
* Facilitate alignment when priorities, dependencies, resource capacity, or delivery expectations span multiple product teams.
* Communicate delivery progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and improvement opportunities clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Influence teams and stakeholders through facilitation, expertise, and data rather than formal reporting authority.
* Collaborate effectively across geographically distributed teams and time zones.

**Required Functional Skills and Qualifications**

**Must-Have Skills**

* Experience in Agile technology or digital product delivery, including hands-on experience as a Release Train Engineer, Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Product Owner, or similar role.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple Agile or Digital Product Teams.
* Strong working knowledge of SAFe, Scrum, Agile principles, product delivery, and continuous improvement.
* Hands-on experience facilitating PI Planning, Agile Release Train activities, Scrum ceremonies, dependency management, risk management, and cross-team planning.
* Experience establishing and managing Agile delivery processes and reporting through JIRA or comparable Agile lifecycle management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to identify delivery impediments and facilitate resolution across organizational and team boundaries.
* Strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate effectively through influence without direct people-management authority.
* Experience working with globally distributed technology and business teams.
* Ability to connect Agile delivery practices with product roadmaps, business outcomes, stakeholder value, and enterprise priorities.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working within or transitioning toward a Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) or comparable product-centric technology operating model.
* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Practice Consultant, or comparable Agile certification.
* Experience supporting multiple Digital Product Teams or an Agile Release Train simultaneously.
* Experience designing or improving Agile delivery operating models, governance structures, JIRA workflows, metrics, or reporting.
* Experience working across digital product, software engineering, data, analytics, and/or AI product teams.
* Experience facilitating organizational change from project-based technology delivery toward persistent product teams and outcome-oriented delivery.
