title: Delivery Director
description:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

We're looking for a Delivery Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation: a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and still growing. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a governance role sitting apart from the work. You'll take direct ownership of how delivery runs day to day, build a high-performing team, and set the tone for its spirit.

You'll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM, who hold technical direction for their respective practices. As the most senior Two Circles leader in Hyderabad, you'll also play an important role in our work with BCCI, our most important partner in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Leading the Team and Its Spirit

* Lead, grow and retain the India delivery team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the spirit of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat this as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and Engineering Excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Partner with our Tech Leads and Engineering Directors to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed and executed well.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, Metrics and Governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team, covering hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality, performance and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how project leaders elsewhere in the business rate the India team's work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
* Keep any scorecard or metrics simple and supportive, not a tool that creates pressure. Psychological safety and performance measurement need to be built together, not treated as separate things.

Client Leadership

* Act as Client Lead for BCCI: our most senior relationship owner in India, accountable for client governance and margin efficiency. We'd expect this to take up roughly 10% of your time.
* Represent our engineering and delivery capability in client meetings in India, drawing on the work we deliver globally.

Global Collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues, and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong spirit in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.

title: Engineering Director
description:
Who We Are

We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

What you will do

We’re looking for an Engineering Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation. You’ll lead a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and the team is still growing. They work across our Data and Digital Products & CRM practices and deliver for clients and colleagues around the world.

You’ll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM. As the most senior Two Circles leader in our Hyderabad office, you’ll also play an important role in our work with the BCCI, our most important partner in India. The role is based in Hyderabad.

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You’ll build and run a high-performing team and set the tone for its culture. You’ll bring discipline and predictability to how we deliver and make the India team’s performance visible to the rest of the business.

You’ll bring enough fluency in engineering and software delivery to earn the respect of our team, understanding trade-offs, spotting risk, and knowing when and how deep to go. You’ll govern quality and standards within the technical direction set by our global Engineering Directors and ensure excellence in the process for how we deliver software. You won’t be expected to set that direction yourself, but you will be expected to make sure it’s executed brilliantly in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Key responsibilitiesLeading the team and its culture

* Lead, grow and retain the India team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the culture of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You’ll treat culture as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and engineering excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Work with our Tech Leads to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed, in line with the direction set by our Engineering Directors for Data and Digital Products & CRM.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, metrics and governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team. It should cover hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality and performance, and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how the project leaders the India team works with in other regions rate its work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.

Global collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.

What success looks like in your first year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong culture in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team’s health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**  

* 15+ years’ experience, including senior leadership of an organisation of 50+ people across engineering, QA and delivery, and experience managing managers.
* Direct leadership of engineering and QA teams, ideally having started your career as an engineer. You can contribute credibly to architecture and code-quality discussions across both data engineering and digital product engineering.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* Strong emotional intelligence and resilience, and the ability to influence senior peers and stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead and inspire teams and engage a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Eligibility to work in India.
* Able to travel regularly to Vancouver, London and Melbourne.

Nice to have

* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with sports and entertainment.
* Experience building or leading a Global Capability Centre or an India-based global delivery hub.

title: Platform Validation Lead / Manager
description:
At **Kandou**, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to **democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution **reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly** while preserving **high bandwidth and ultra-low latency** — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

We are looking for a Platform Validation Lead/Manager

Location: Hyderabad, India

**Responsabilities**

* Own the Hyderabad platform-validation strategy for Ethernet Retimers, converting product, silicon, firmware and standards requirements into traceable test plans, entry and exit criteria, sample coverage and release decisions.
* Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon validation using simulation, FPGA or emulation and hardware-in-loop environments; drive first-silicon bring-up through power, clocks, boot, register access and module enumeration.
* Validate server and switch host integration, CMIS module-management state machines, I2C/SMBus and SPI mailbox flows, hot-plug, power sequencing, telemetry, diagnostics and fault recovery.
* Build automated regression, conformance and release-readiness workflows with requirements-to-test traceability, reproducible configurations, a known-failure catalog and evidence-based defect disposition.
* Lead and mentor the Hyderabad validation team; establish benches, equipment and lab processes, plan capacity, review results and remain hands-on in system-level debug and root-cause isolation.
* Partner across Hyderabad, Lausanne and Taiwan with SoC, DV, firmware, characterization, interoperability, product and field teams to correlate results and deliver qualified customer-ready releases.

**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years of silicon, system or platform validation experience on shipping SoCs, networking silicon, SerDes, retimers, PHYs, AEC/AOC or optical-module products.
* Direct ownership of at least one pre-silicon-to-post-silicon validation cycle, including first-silicon or board bring-up, qualification and release-readiness decisions.
* Hands-on system debug across silicon, boards, firmware, drivers and host applications, using JTAG, register traces, oscilloscopes, BERTs and related lab tools.
* Strong validation automation skills in Python and working C and/or C++ knowledge; experience with hardware-in-loop frameworks, CI, version control and reproducible test environments.
* Experience validating management and sideband interfaces such as CMIS, I2C//I3CSMBus, SPI, MDIO or MCTP, including state transitions, error paths, hot-plug and recovery behavior.
* Demonstrated requirements-traceable validation discipline: verification methods, pass/fail criteria, sample plans, environmental conditions, guard bands and clear evidence packages.
* Proven technical and people leadership, including hiring or mentoring engineers, managing lab priorities and driving cross-functional defect closure under a fixed schedule.

Excellent written and verbal communication; BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience. Ability to travel for bring-up and partner qualification windows.

**Useful Experience**

* Validation of 100G/lane or 200G/lane Ethernet, PAM4 SerDes, retimers, PHYs, AEC/AOC or optical modules.
* IEEE 802.3, OIF-CEI, CMIS 5.x, OSFP MSA or related electrical and module-management conformance.
* BER and FEC validation, link training and equalization, loopback test, eye and margin analysis, and correlation with characterization data.
* Secure boot, authenticated firmware update, image signing, rollback and recovery-path validation.
* Hyperscaler or tier-one OEM qualification, NIC or switch-ASIC interoperability, plugfests and customer escalation support.
* ATE or manufacturing-test correlation, EIA-364 or JEDEC qualification exposure, thermal and power validation, and multi-site program leadership.

**Job Overview:**

The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and evolution of the organization's end user technology ecosystem. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for the Microsoft 365 platform and related productivity, collaboration, and security services — driving adoption, standardization, and innovation across the enterprise.


The EUC Architect partners closely with business stakeholders, IT operations teams, security, and enterprise architecture to ensure the end user environment is modern, resilient, and aligned with organizational objectives. **Responsibilities:**

* Lead architectural decisions for Microsoft Copilot adoption, including readiness assessments, data governance prerequisites, and rollout strategy
* Design and maintain identity and access architecture in partnership with the IAM team, including Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access, SSPR, MFA, and hybrid identity models

**End User Computing Strategy**
-------------------------------

* Define the long\-term EUC strategy spanning physical endpoints (Windows, macOS), virtual desktop infrastructure (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365\), and mobile platforms (iOS, Android) via Microsoft Intune
* Lead endpoint lifecycle architecture including OS imaging, patching strategy, hardware standards, and Windows 11 migration planning
* Architect solutions for remote and hybrid work scenarios, ensuring performance, security, and user experience parity regardless of location
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and communicate business value and architectural impact to leadership

**Governance \& Standards**

* Develop and maintain EUC architecture standards, reference architectures, and design documentation

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on EUC and M365 capabilities, roadmap, and investment priorities
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, networking, and application teams to ensure integrated, cohesive solutions

* Represent EUC architecture in governance forums, architecture review boards, and vendor engagements

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work

	+ **Identity \& Access:** Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, MFA, Privileged Identity Management
	+ **Device Management:** Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Windows Autopilot
	+ **Security:** Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365
	+ **Compliance:** Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, DLP, eDiscovery
	+ **Automation \& Platform:** Power Platform, Microsoft Graph API
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing M365 tenant architecture in large, complex enterprise environments
* Strong understanding of hybrid identity models, Azure AD Connect, and cloud\-only identity scenarios
* Experience with virtual desktop technologies (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms and their integration with M365 tooling (e.g., ServiceNow)

**Core Competencies:**

**Preferences:**

The Data Architecture job family involves leading the data design for an application, solution, or business domain, helping to define how data will flow, and be stored and structured.


We are looking for an Architect to join our Supply Chain Innovation organization and lead the design of enterprise\-scale Generative AI solutions that run on top of P\&G's data platform. At P\&G, AI is not a standalone experiment — it is an operational interface over the data that runs our business, from supply chain and vendor systems to retail distribution and consumer insights. In this role you will own the architecture for how our AI systems retrieve, reason over, and act on enterprise data, working hands\-on while setting the standards other engineering teams build against. This is an exciting opportunity for a self\-motivated architect who enjoys solving complex technical problems and delivering high\-impact global solutions.


Key Responsibilities:

* Own end\-to\-end architecture for enterprise GenAI solutions — retrieval, orchestration, integration, and evaluation — ensuring they are scalable, secure, and aligned to business outcomes.
* Design production retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures over enterprise data, including document ingestion and chunking, indexing strategy, hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval, re\-ranking, and relevance tuning.
* Architect multi\-phase agent and tool\-calling workflows with deterministic guardrails — scoped tool access, structured output schemas, validation, bounded retries, explicit completion contracts, and fallback handling — so that non\-deterministic models meet production reliability standards.
* Design the data ingestion and synchronization foundations that support AI grounding — streaming and change data capture from enterprise sources, canonical data models, and incremental sync that keeps indexes and downstream systems current.
* Enforce data governance and strict multi\-tenant isolation boundaries across brands, regions, and partners, applying access control, PII protection, and Responsible AI principles by default.
* Establish evaluation and observability standards for AI workloads — curated test sets, automated quality scoring including model\-based judging, regression suites in CI/CD, and end\-to\-end tracing of model behavior in production.
* Own the operational economics of AI systems: latency and throughput targets, inference and token cost management, caching strategies, and routing work to the appropriate model for the task.
* Act as the principal technical authority for AI architecture — lead design reviews, resolve complex performance and integration issues, mentor engineers, and champion Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.


Ideal Candidate:

* A hands\-on architect who can independently design end\-to\-end solutions while remaining active in development, code review, and production problem\-solving.
* Treats AI systems as distributed data systems — designs for failure, latency, duplication, and drift rather than assuming the happy path.
* Collaborative and self\-motivated, able to work across global teams, influence stakeholders without formal authority, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

 **About us**


We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head \& Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral\-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.


Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, with a significant focus on architecture and technical leadership of large\-scale, multi\-tenant, or high\-throughput platforms.
* Hands\-on experience designing and delivering production Generative AI solutions — retrieval\-augmented generation, LLM\-based classification and extraction, or multi\-phase agent workflows — including the schema validation, guardrails, and fallback logic that make them dependable.
* Proven experience architecting orchestration layers for distributed systems — event\-driven and streaming pipelines, workflow and state management, idempotency, bounded retries, and recovery from partial failure — and applying the same discipline to AI and agent workflows.
* Strong grounding in search and retrieval: inverted indexes and lexical relevance scoring, vector and semantic similarity, hybrid retrieval and rank fusion, re\-ranking, and the effect of data freshness on retrieval quality.
* Experience defining quality and evaluation practices for probabilistic systems — curated test sets, regression suites, automated and model\-based scoring of output quality, and production tracing.


 Experience integrating heterogeneous enterprise systems and data sources at scale across streaming, API, and file\-based patterns, with strong data modeling and schema governance instincts. programming skills in at least one backend language (Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or similar), with hands\-on experience across document and relational data stores.

* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.


Preferred: Working knowledge of modern lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) and medallion data architectures; familiarity with AI governance, guardrails, and evaluation tooling; experience integrating enterprise systems; experience designing for regulated or highly sensitive data environments.

description:
About Signant Health
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  

About the Role
  
The IT Applications Engineer is a generalist engineering and support role responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Signant Health's core business applications. The role carries particular depth in NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Box, and Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence), while also supporting the broader enterprise application portfolio as needed.
  
This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role that blends technical engineering — configuration, scripting, integrations, automations, and upgrades — with day\-to\-day operational support — tickets, incidents, and user requests. The IT Applications Engineer is a trusted first\- and second\-line point of contact for application issues, and is equally comfortable delivering enhancements and automations that improve reliability and reduce manual effort across the application landscape. Where the IT Application Operations Manager sets direction and leads the team, this role does the technical and support work directly, partnering closely with the Service Operations, Infrastructure Operations, and Security Operations teams.
  
  

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function
  
1\. Application Administration \& Configuration — Own day\-to\-day administration and configuration of NetSuite, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID), Box, and Atlassian (Jira, JSM, Confluence), plus other assigned enterprise applications, including user provisioning, permissions, and platform settings.
  
2\. Technical Support \& Incident Resolution — Act as a key point of escalation for tier 2/3 application support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues across the supported application stack and coordinating with vendors and other IT teams as needed.
  
3\. Engineering \& Customization — Build and maintain customizations to meet business requirements — including SuiteScript/SuiteFlow (NetSuite), Power Automate/Graph API automations (Microsoft 365\), workflow and scripting configuration (Atlassian), and equivalent customizations for other supported applications.
  
4\. Integrations \& Automation — Develop and support integrations between applications using APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tooling, building automations that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  
5\. Change, Release \& Patch Management — Plan, test, and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes across supported applications, minimizing disruption to the business.
  
6\. Security \& Compliance — Apply access control, licensing, and data\-handling practices aligned with company security policy and relevant regulatory and quality requirements.
  
7\. Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement — Monitor application health, usage, and performance; proactively identify issues and recommend and implement improvements.
  
8\. Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination — Liaise with software vendors and business stakeholders on support cases, licensing, and roadmap requests for supported platforms.
  
9\. Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing — Maintain runbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge base articles; participate in knowledge transfer and cross\-training to build coverage across the application portfolio.
  
10\. AI \& Automation Adoption — Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI\-assisted tooling, agents, and low\-code automation to improve support efficiency and business workflows.
  
11\. Roadmap Support — Contribute to application\-specific roadmaps for releases, improvements, and vendor\-provided enhancements, in partnership with the IT Application Operations Manager.
  
  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES
  
  

**Essential:**  

1\. NetSuite — Administration and configuration; SuiteScript 2\.x and SuiteFlow; saved searches/SuiteAnalytics; SuiteTalk and REST API integrations.
  
2\. Microsoft 365 — Administration of Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, and Entra ID (Azure AD); familiarity with Intune and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
  
3\. Box — Content management administration, permissions and governance, and API\-based integrations.
  
4\. Atlassian — Administration and configuration of Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including workflow design and scripting (e.g., ScriptRunner).
  
5\. APIs \& Integrations — Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tools (e.g., Power Automate, N8N, Boomi) for connecting applications.
  
6\. Scripting \& Automation — Proficiency in at least one scripting language (JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python) for customization, troubleshooting, and automation.
  
7\. Application Lifecycle Management — Experience with patching, upgrades, testing, and change management for SaaS/cloud and on\-premise applications.
  
8\. Security \& Compliance Awareness — Understanding of access management, data protection, and relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GxP where applicable).
  
9\. ITSM \& Monitoring Tools — Familiarity with ticketing/ITSM tooling (e.g., Jira Service Management) and application monitoring/observability tools.
  
  

**Desirable:**  

1\. Clear and effective communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  
2\. Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
  
3\. Good organizational and time\-management skills across competing priorities.
  
4\. Ability to document clearly and concisely for varied audiences.
  
5\. Adaptability and resilience amid changing priorities and technologies.
  
6\. Effective cross\-team collaboration with Infrastructure, Security, Automation, and Business Analyst teams.
  
  

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  

If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
 At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.
   

  

 AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high\-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go\-to\-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
   

  

**The Role**
 The focus of this role is to plan, build, Design/Integration of new and existing features for AMD’s graphics processor IP, resulting in no bugs in the final design.
   

  

  

  

**THE PERSON:** 
  

  

 You have a passion for modern, complex processor architecture, digital design, and verification in general. You are a team player who has excellent communication skills and experience collaborating with other engineers located in different sites/timezones. You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills and are willing to learn and ready to take on problems.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define SoC and subsystem power architecture.
* Develop and maintain power intent using UPF/CPF methodologies.
* Implement low\-power techniques such as:
+ Power gating
+ Clock gating
+ Multi\-voltage domains
+ Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS)
+ Retention and isolation strategies

* Collaborate with RTL designers to integrate low\-power features.
* Run and debug low\-power checks using EDA tools.
* Perform power estimation, analysis, and optimization throughout the design cycle.
* Drive power signoff activities and ensure compliance with project power budgets.
* Support functional verification teams in low\-power verification planning and execution.


**Required Skills**
**Technical Skills**
* Strong knowledge of digital IC/SoC design flow.
* Expertise in:
+ UPF (Unified Power Format)
+ CPF (Common Power Format)
+ Power\-aware simulation and verification
+ Low\-power design methodologies

* Experience with industry\-standard EDA tools (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens/Mentor).
* Understanding of RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog).
* Knowledge of static timing, synthesis, and implementation flows.
* Familiarity with power analysis tools and methodologies.


**Programming/Scripting**
* Tcl
* Perl/Python
* Shell scripting


**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:** 
  

  

* Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

### **Summary**

The Senior Analyst is responsible for delivering data\-driven insights and analytics that support global Radioligand Therapy (RLT) Technical Operations.
  

  

The role partners with manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and operational teams to transform complex business data into actionable dashboards, KPIs, and performance insights.
  

  

By leveraging advanced analytics tools and business process knowledge, the Senior Analyst enables informed decision\-making, identifies process improvement opportunities, and drives operational excellence across the global RLT network.
### **About the Role**

**Major accountabilities:**

* Develop and maintain analytics, dashboards, and KPI reporting to support global TechOps decision\-making across Radioligand Therapy (RLT) operations.
* Source, transform, cleanse, and analyze data from multiple business systems to generate actionable business insights.
* Design and deliver Power BI visualizations that improve operational transparency and performance monitoring.
* Support manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and operational teams through data\-driven analysis and reporting.

* Translate business requirements into meaningful metrics, reports, and analytical solutions aligned with strategic objectives.
* Monitor operational performance indicators such as lead times, process adherence, on\-time execution, and production performance.

* Contribute to process mapping, continuous improvement initiatives, and system enhancement projects.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders across RLT manufacturing sites to support operational excellence and performance improvement.

**Essential requirements:**

* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or a related field

* Expert\-level Power BI capabilities, including dashboard development and data visualization.
* Experience translating business requirements into actionable insights and performance metrics.
* Experience working with manufacturing, supply chain, quality, or operational datasets within a regulated environment.
* Previous experience within the pharmaceutical industry, with exposure to Radioligand Therapy, Oncology Technical Operations, or radioactive\-product manufacturing environments.

* Working knowledge of Snowflake and ERP systems (preferably SAP or Microsoft D365\).

At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Microsoft Fabric Analytics BA and Developer**
**Overview**
 TTEC Digital is seeking a Microsoft Fabric Analytics BA and Developer to help design, build, and support enterprise analytics solutions across Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, OneLake, lakehouses, warehouses, semantic models, data pipelines, and reporting experiences. This hybrid role bridges business analysis and hands\-on development: partnering with stakeholders to define reporting needs, translate requirements into analytics\-ready designs, and deliver governed, scalable data products that improve decision\-making across the organization. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between business conversations, data modeling, report development, testing, documentation, and production support within an Agile delivery model.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Business Analysis and Requirements Definition
* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, analysts, and technical teams to understand reporting needs, business processes, data definitions, and decision\-making objectives
* Translate business requests into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data mappings, and report specifications
* Facilitate discovery sessions to clarify source systems, metric definitions, calculation logic, security needs, refresh expectations, and user experience requirements
* Identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and data quality concerns early, and recommend practical options that balance speed, scalability, governance, and business value
* Maintain functional documentation that supports development, testing, adoption, training, and long\-term support
* Microsoft Fabric Solution Development
* Design, develop, test, and support analytics assets in Microsoft Fabric, including lake houses, warehouses, dataflows, pipelines, semantic models, and Power BI reports
* Build and maintain data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration patterns using Fabric Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, notebooks, SQL, or other approved Fabric capabilities
* Create curated, analytics\-ready data structures using OneLake, lakehouse, warehouse, and dimensional modeling patterns
* Develop reusable semantic models that support consistent measures, relationships, hierarchies, security, performance, and enterprise reporting standards
* Apply Microsoft Fabric best practices for workspace organization, item ownership, deployment readiness, monitoring, and supportability
* Power BI Reporting, Analytics, and Data Modeling
* Design, build, and enhance Power BI reports, dashboards, and analytical experiences that are intuitive, performant, and aligned to stakeholder needs
* Develop semantic models, DAX measures, relationships, calculation logic, and report interactions that support accurate and reusable analytics
* Optimize report performance, model design, refresh patterns, and user experience across enterprise\-scale datasets
* Support data validation, reconciliation, and metric governance to ensure business users trust the outputs they consume
* Collaborate with business users to interpret findings, refine reporting requirements, and improve adoption of analytics solutions
* Data Governance, Security, and Lifecycle Management
* Follow enterprise standards for data access, workspace security, sensitivity, privacy, retention, compliance, and operational support
* Implement and validate appropriate security patterns, including workspace permissions, item access, row\-level security, object\-level security, and data\-sharing controls where applicable
* Use approved lifecycle practices such as Git integration, deployment pipelines, Azure DevOps, version control, release documentation, and deployment validation
* Document data lineage, source\-to\-target mappings, transformation logic, model assumptions, refresh dependencies, and support procedures
* Partner with administrators, architects, and data owners to align Fabric solutions with governance, capacity, monitoring, and platform standards
* Agile Delivery, Testing, and Stakeholder Enablement
* Participate actively in sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, retrospectives, solution design discussions, and release readiness activities
* Lead or support unit testing, data validation, system testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage, and production of hyper care
* Create clear release notes, training materials, support documentation, and adoption guidance for analytics consumers
* Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, data limitations, and technical tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Provide knowledge sharing and enablement to business users, analysts, report developers, and support teams to improve analytics maturity and self\-service adoption


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills and Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience
* 4\+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, data analysis, data engineering, reporting, or related technology delivery
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or related Microsoft analytics technologies
* Strong business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, user story creation, acceptance criteria, data mapping, process analysis, and stakeholder facilitation
* Experience building Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, DAX measures, and reusable reporting datasets
* Working knowledge of SQL, dimensional modeling, data quality validation, source\-to\-target mapping, and analytical data design
* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric concepts such as OneLake, lakehouses, warehouses, data pipelines, dataflows, notebooks, deployment pipelines, and workspace management
* Ability to troubleshoot reporting, model, refresh, data quality, permissions, and production support issues across development, test, and production environments
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data concepts and technical tradeoffs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders


**Preferred Skills**
* Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Power BI Data Analyst Associate, Fabric Data Engineer Associate, or related Microsoft certification
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric lakehouse or warehouse architecture, Medallion patterns, Direct Lake, shortcuts, mirroring, or enterprise\-scale semantic model design
* Experience with PySpark, KQL, T\-SQL, Dataflows Gen2, Fabric notebooks, Real\-Time Intelligence, or advanced data pipeline development
* Experience with Git integration, Azure DevOps, deployment pipelines, release management, and governed analytics lifecycle practices
* Familiarity with Microsoft Purview, data cataloging, lineage, sensitivity labels, data governance, and enterprise security practices
* Experience working in a Microsoft partner, consulting, professional services, CX, contact center, or enterprise IT environment


**Key Attributes**
* Business\-outcome mindset: connects analytics capability to better decisions, operational visibility, productivity, and measurable business value
* Analytical curiosity: asks strong questions, validates assumptions, and digs into data issues until the business meaning is clear
* Systems thinking understands how source systems, pipelines, data models, security, reports, governance, and adoption work together across an analytics platform
* Delivery discipline: moves quickly while maintaining quality, documentation, testing, traceability, and supportability
* Governance\-minded: designs with access, data protection, metric consistency, lineage, and long\-term ownership in mind from the start
* Collaborative: builds productive relationships with business stakeholders, data owners, analysts, architects, administrators, developers, and support teams

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**


We are seeking an experienced Power Platform engineer to design and deliver complex enterprise solutions for clients while helping raise the technical capability of our broader Power Platform team.


This is a hands\-on player coach role with significant client delivery responsibility. The Manager will remain deeply involved in solution architecture, software development, troubleshooting, implementation, technical reviews, and client discussions. This is not a primarily administrative or people management position.


The ideal candidate is a software engineer with deep Microsoft Power Platform expertise who can combine low code capabilities with custom development, enterprise architecture, and strong consulting skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a hands\-on engineer and technical lead for complex client engagements involving Microsoft Power Platform.
* Design and build enterprise applications using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and related Microsoft technologies.
* Develop custom solutions using C\#/.NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, and other extensibility approaches.
* Design scalable Dataverse architectures, including data models, security, integrations, business logic, and performance considerations.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, APIs, and other enterprise systems.
* Implement strong ALM practices including source control, solution management, deployment automation, environment strategy, and CI/CD.
* Lead technical discovery sessions and translate business requirements into practical, well\-designed solutions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership across multiple engagements and act as an escalation point for complex engineering challenges.
* Establish and promote engineering standards, reusable patterns, code quality expectations, and delivery best practices.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads and help improve engineering quality across the broader team.
* Help teams determine when Power Platform is the right solution and when custom development or other technologies are more appropriate.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8 or more years of professional software engineering, application development, solution architecture, or related technology experience.
* 4 or more years of substantial hands\-on Microsoft Power Platform engineering experience.
* Strong software development experience using C\#/.NET and JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience extending Power Platform through plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security, data modeling, integration patterns, solution management, and performance.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems.
* Experience with Azure services, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, and related technologies.
* Strong experience with ALM, source control, deployment automation, managed solutions, and CI/CD.
* Strong understanding of professional software engineering practices including code review, testing, debugging, monitoring, and production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on complex enterprise application projects.
* Strong client facing communication, consulting, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and provide clear recommendations.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team.
* Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams, including appropriate overlap with US based stakeholders when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security standards, or Center of Excellence practices.
* Experience with Azure technologies such as Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
* Experience working in consulting or professional services environments.
* Experience supporting presales, estimation, technical proposals, demonstrations, or workshops.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications such as PL 400, PL 600, or related credentials.

**What Success Looks Like**


Successful engineers in this role remain highly engaged in client delivery while also raising the technical capability of the broader team. They are trusted by clients, comfortable solving difficult engineering problems, able to make sound architecture decisions, and capable of guiding others through complex technical challenges.


They approach Power Platform as an enterprise application development platform and combine its native capabilities with strong software engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions.

 **What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.


We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

description:
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years verifying IP that has to work in real silicon, not just pass regression. You know that closing coverage is not about hitting a number, it is about understanding what you have not tested yet and why that matters. Protocol specs do not intimidate you. You read them, translate them into test plans, and build environments that catch the corner cases three months before tapeout.


You are the person design teams come to when a regression fails at 3 a.m. and no one can figure out why. You open Verdi, trace the transactions, correlate protocol behavior with RTL state, and find the root cause while others are still guessing. UVM is a tool you use well, not a checkbox you tick. You write clean agents, extend sequences without breaking existing tests, and build scoreboards that actually catch bugs.


Mentoring matters to you. When a junior engineer gets stuck on a constrained\-random failure, you do not just fix it, you show them how to think through it. You communicate clearly across teams, whether you are explaining a coverage gap to an architect or walking a design lead through a protocol violation. At Synopsys, you will work on high\-speed interconnect IP that powers the next generation of AI and compute systems, and what you verify will ship.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Own end\-to\-end verification of UCIe, PCIe, or DDR IP blocks, from test planning and environment bring\-up through coverage closure and sign\-off
* Build and extend UVM testbenches in SystemVerilog, including agents, sequencers, scoreboards, coverage models, and protocol checkers
* Write directed and constrained\-random tests that stress protocol compliance, corner cases, and multi\-layer interactions
* Debug complex RTL and testbench failures using Synopsys Verdi, including waveform analysis, protocol trace, and transaction\-level debug
* Translate protocol specifications into executable test plans, assertions (SVA), and functional coverage models that map to real silicon risk
* Collaborate with design, architecture, and silicon validation teams on bug triage, ECO impact analysis, and bring\-up readiness
* Mentor verification engineers on UVM methodology, debug techniques, and protocol understanding, and contribute to design and verification reviews

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* You will close coverage gaps and catch protocol violations that prevent costly respins and silicon failures
* Your testbenches will become the foundation for future IP releases, reused and extended across product generations
* Design teams will ship with confidence because your verification caught the issues that matter before tapeout
* Junior engineers will level up faster because you showed them how to debug like a senior engineer, not just run regressions
* Cross\-functional teams will make better decisions because you explained the verification risk clearly and early
* Silicon validation will spend less time debugging because your pre\-silicon verification was thorough and well\-documented
* The IP you verify will enable high\-speed interconnects in AI accelerators, data center chips, and next\-generation compute platforms used by customers worldwide

### **What You'll Need**

* 7\+ years of hands\-on ASIC or SoC design verification experience, with at least 3 years on protocol\-heavy IP
* Deep working knowledge of at least one high\-speed protocol: PCIe, UCIe, or DDR, with the ability to read specs and build compliant testbenches
* Strong UVM methodology experience, including building agents, writing constrained\-random sequences, implementing scoreboards, and closing functional coverage
* Solid SystemVerilog skills, including object\-oriented programming, constrained\-random stimulus generation, and SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA)
* Proven ability to debug complex failures using Synopsys Verdi or equivalent tools (FSDB, protocol analyzers, transaction\-level debug)
* Experience with industry simulators such as VCS, Xcelium, or Questa, and familiarity with regression and coverage tools like URG
* B.Tech or M.Tech in Electronics, VLSI, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline; working knowledge of a second protocol (PCIe, UCIe, DDR, CXL) is a strong plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can open a 500\-page protocol spec, find the state machine that matters, and turn it into a test plan and coverage model within a week
* When a regression fails intermittently, you do not rerun it and hope, you reproduce it, trace it in Verdi, and document the root cause for the design team
* You write UVM code that other engineers can read and extend six months later without asking you what it does
* You push back when a test plan is too shallow or a coverage model misses a critical scenario, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward
* You can explain a protocol violation to a design engineer in two sentences, then walk an architect through the same issue at the transaction level without losing the thread
* You treat verification like a product: your environments are maintainable, your tests are reusable, and your documentation helps the next person who touches your code

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!


Our Values

**Best Life**


We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**


We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**


From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


Build the AI platform foundations

* Write and ship production code for core AI platform services, APIs, orchestration components, evaluation systems, SDKs, and internal developer tools.
* Design, build, and operate reusable AI platform capabilities such as chat APIs, RAG services, summarization, classification, semantic search, prompt/workflow execution, and agent orchestration.
* Build high\-quality APIs, SDKs, templates, and reference implementations that product teams can adopt with minimal friction.
* Create production\-ready orchestration patterns for retrieval, tool use, validation, fallback handling, memory/state management, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Stay close to implementation details by reviewing PRs, debugging production issues, improving reliability, and making pragmatic technical tradeoffs with the team.
* Partner with SRE, Security, Platform, and Product Engineering teams to ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, secure, observable, and cost\-aware.


Own evaluation, reliability, and production readiness

* Build evaluation harnesses for LLM\-powered systems, including curated test sets, scenario\-based evaluations, regression checks, quality gates, and release criteria.
* Implement AI observability practices such as tracing, prompt/version tracking, output quality monitoring, latency tracking, token/cost visibility, and production feedback loops.
* Design safe defaults for AI systems, including structured outputs, tool permissions, prompt\-injection awareness, data handling controls, fallback paths, and failure\-mode handling.
* Ensure AI capabilities are built with strong production fundamentals: testing, monitoring, rollout strategy, incident readiness, performance tuning, and cost management.
* Help teams move from prototypes to production by identifying gaps in reliability, observability, security, evaluation, and operational readiness.


Drive AI adoption across ABC

* Establish the “ABC Way” of building production AI systems through patterns, standards, documentation, code examples, architecture reviews, and technical enablement.
* Work directly with product teams to help them adopt the platform, unblock implementation challenges, and turn early AI ideas into production\-ready features.
* Lead technical design reviews and architecture forums for AI systems, ensuring teams make sound decisions around quality, safety, reliability, and maintainability.
* Identify repeated friction across teams and convert it into reusable platform capabilities.
* Help raise AI engineering capability across the company through internal demos, enablement sessions, office hours, technical write\-ups, and engineering blog posts.


Lead through technical influence

* Act as a hands\-on technical leader and multiplier, not just an advisor.
* Set technical direction for complex AI platform areas and align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Security, SRE, and Data.
* Mentor engineers on production AI engineering practices, backend design, system reliability, evaluation strategy, and AI\-native development workflows.
* Help teams use AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve development speed, testing, debugging, documentation, and iteration without compromising quality.

  

WHAT THIS IS NOT

* Not a data science role focused on analysis, experimentation, or dashboards.
* Not an ML research role focused on training foundation models from scratch.
* Not a prompt\-only role without ownership of production systems.
* Not building one\-off AI features for a single product line.
* Not an architecture\-only role where you primarily create diagrams, review designs, or delegate implementation to others.
* Not a people\-management role. You will influence, mentor, and lead through technical depth, but this is an individual contributor position.


This is a hands\-on platform engineering role focused on building the systems, standards, and paved paths that make AI production\-ready across ABC.

  

QUALIFICATIONS:

* Significant hands\-on engineering experience, typically 10\+ years, with strong backend/platform engineering depth.
* Recent hands\-on experience building and operating production backend/platform systems. You should be comfortable going deep into code, APIs, infrastructure, observability, debugging, and production tradeoffs.
* Proven experience building and shipping production\-grade AI/LLM systems such as RAG, agent workflows, tool\-calling systems, AI APIs, or LLM\-powered product capabilities.
* Strong programming experience, preferably in Python and/or backend service stacks used for production APIs and distributed systems.
* Deep understanding of API design, service boundaries, SDKs, integration patterns, reliability, testing, observability, performance, and cost optimization.
* Practical experience with LLM application architecture: context engineering, retrieval patterns, tool use, structured outputs, orchestration, fallback handling, and evaluation.
* Ability to build evaluation and validation systems for AI applications, including golden datasets, scenario\-based tests, regression checks, and quality gates.
* Experience deploying and operating cloud\-based production systems on AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar platforms.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to make tradeoffs across speed, reliability, safety, cost, developer experience, and business impact.
* Ability to lead through hands\-on technical contribution: writing code, creating reference implementations, reviewing designs, mentoring engineers, and turning ambiguous platform needs into working systems.
* Proven ability to influence across teams through architecture reviews, design documents, technical standards, mentorship, and hands\-on partnership.

  

AND IT’S GREAT TO HAVE

* Experience building internal developer platforms, SDKs, shared services, or paved\-path tooling.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM observability/evaluation tooling such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Open Telemetry\-based tracing, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or custom orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with vector databases, embedding workflows, semantic search, retrieval tuning, and RAG productionization.
* Experience with AI\-native engineering workflows using tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools.
* Experience writing technical blogs, internal engineering guides, architecture documents, or enablement material that helps engineering teams adopt new practices.
* Experience leading technical standards or architecture forums across multiple engineering teams.

  

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE


Adoption


Product teams across ABC use the AI Enablement Platform as the default starting point for AI\-powered features.


Velocity


Teams can move from AI idea to production feature significantly faster because reusable APIs, SDKs, templates, evals, and guardrails are already available.


Trust


AI systems are observable, measurable, debuggable, and safe to operate in production.


Quality


Teams have clear evaluation practices, regression checks, and release gates for LLM\-powered workflows.


Reuse


Repeated AI patterns become shared capabilities instead of one\-off implementations across product teams.


Influence


The “ABC Way” of building AI systems becomes widely understood through architecture reviews, documentation, internal demos, and engineering best practices.


AI\-native engineering


Engineering teams use AI tools and platform capabilities to improve how software is designed, built, tested, reviewed, documented, and operated.

  

WHY THIS MATTERS


If we get this right, AI at ABC Fitness will not be a collection of isolated experiments. It will become a core engineering capability that every team can use to build better products faster.


This role will help define how ABC builds AI\-powered software: production\-first, safe by default, measurable, reusable, and deeply integrated into the way engineering teams work.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. \#oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee \+ spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent\-in\-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers


At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.


About ABC Fitness


ABC Fitness is the \#1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data\-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.


From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

title: Sr Staff Digital Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world\-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.


Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

 **Job Description**  

* This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Senior Hardware Verification Engineer using UVM, located at Hyderabad, India
* The role involves developing and maintaining UVM\-based verification environments, writing test benches, test cases, and coverage models for complex IP and SoC designs.
* The engineer will analyze specifications, define verification plans, create and execute verification scenarios, and debug RTL issues in close collaboration with design, architecture, and firmware teams.
* Daily tasks include running regressions, monitoring coverage metrics, performing root\-cause analysis of failures, and contributing to continuous improvement of verification methodologies and automation.
* The role may also include mentoring junior engineers, participating in design and verification reviews, and aligning verification activities with project schedules and quality standards.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 12\+ years of experience in Digital Verification with Strong expertise in System Verilog, UVM methodology and constrained\-random verification.
* Experience with Formal Verification techniques and tools to complement simulation\-based verification \- advantage.
* Solid understanding of Computer Architecture, including memory hierarchies, bus protocols, and high\-performance compute subsystems.
* Proficiency with verification tools and flows (e.g., simulators, waveform viewers, coverage tools, regression management, scripting in Python/Perl/Tcl).
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in cross\-functional, multicultural teams.
* Experience in semiconductor product development for automotive, industrial, or embedded systems is an advantage
* Strong English, availability to support and cooperate with external teams including Business travels.
* Experience using AI tools to accelerate code development, debugging, and improvement is an advantage.

  

**Additional Information**  

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**.
